The Eternal Crucible - Arena Floor.description: The central competition ground can be cleared for duels, tournaments, and demonstrations.

The Magistrate's Hall - Public Vestibule.description: Visitors enter through a formal foyer with directions to offices and hearing rooms.

The Magistrate's Hall - Waiting Gallery.description: A quiet public area lets visitors wait outside the hearing rooms.

The Magistrate's Hall - Records Room.description: Shelves and desks hold court documents and administrative materials.

Evertree Base.name: Evertree Base
Evertree Base.basicInfo: Controlled palace approaches lead to roots where dense mana is almost tangible. Authorized researchers and maintenance personnel can make approved observations or assist a defined task. Strength, academy membership, and a casual palace visit do not grant entry. Its Portal Room provides controlled travel to Drakenspire Mountains and Asterveil Sky Archipelago. Passage can be arranged for authorized expeditions and other actual permitted travel; transit access does not grant research access to the tree or palace. Its Portal Room is Glowhaven’s sole portal hub: every external return arch lands here, inside this location.

Evertree Base - Rear Palace Walk.description: A restricted walk runs behind the palace toward the Evertree's base.

Evertree Base - Rootward Court.description: A quiet enclosed space stands beneath the Evertree, framed by palace grounds.

Evertree Base - Portal Room.description: A vaulted transit chamber beneath the Evertree's rootward structures, reached through the controlled entrance from Rear Palace Walk. Stone-framed arches serve the Drakenspire and Asterveil routes. An issued route key opens its matching passage; permitted passengers need not cast. The room receives return traffic from both routes. Destination keys select the two ordinary outbound arches. Fixed return arches lead directly back to this room, with no second landing request. A Glowhaven Portal Key records that same home route; it does not create another portal. This is the only portal room in Glowhaven. External returns end on its floor; another city landing is never a route choice.

Prison Records Office.name: Prison Records Office
Prison Records Office.basicInfo: Case copies, sentence and review dates, work orders, and release paperwork are processed in a controlled records building.
Prison Records Office.hiddenInfo: Akira Oritsu can submit requests within his duties; the original court remains responsible for its judgments. A genuine discrepancy can produce a correction, review, or reasoned refusal. Merely wanting release does not establish an error. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

Prison Records Office - Case Counter.description: Authorized applicants request a cited case copy or correction. Private files are not open browsing.

Prison Records Office - Review Room.description: Permitted interviews compare actual evidence, dates, and recorded decisions.

Prison Records Office - Secure Archive.description: Original custody records and sealed correspondence are kept behind restricted access.

Holding Cells.name: Holding Cells
Holding Cells.basicInfo:
A monitored detention block holds recent arrivals, people awaiting review, and prisoners awaiting authorized movement. Custody status determines access, not personal popularity.

Mizue Akeboshi keeps her permitted things in careful order and is a familiar presence along the common corridor.
Holding Cells.hiddenInfo: Talking, requesting counsel or review, and asking about a work assignment remain possible within restrictions. Cell doors and escorted corridors remain secured. Detention does not imply an already completed conviction. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

Holding Cells - Common Corridor.description: A watched corridor connects assigned cells and an escort checkpoint.

Holding Cells - Cell Range.description: Ordinary holding cells provide space to rest and speak within the actual custody rules.

Holding Cells - Escort Checkpoint.description: An officer verifies movement authority before admitting anyone to other facilities.

High-Security Cellblock.name: High-Security Cellblock
High-Security Cellblock.basicInfo: A reinforced block contains prisoners whose actual records require stronger supervision and specialized magical containment.
High-Security Cellblock.hiddenInfo: Security combines maintained wards, trained staff, physical barriers, and procedures suited to the actual threat. It is not universal immunity to every spell. Access and any discovered weakness require evidence; no convenient breach appears simply because escape is desired. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

High-Security Cellblock - Ward Checkpoin.description: Identity, escort authority, and active containment measures are checked before entry.

High-Security Cellblock - Reinforced Cor.description: Monitored passages separate secured cells and interrupt unauthorized movement.

High-Security Cellblock - Secured Cells.description: Individual restrictions follow recorded risks and orders. High security does not grant staff omniscience.

Prison Work Yard.name: Prison Work Yard
Prison Work Yard.basicInfo: Supervised maintenance and assigned work take place around a muster point and practical workshops. Akira Oritsu checks assigned escorts, tools, and completed handovers here.
Prison Work Yard.hiddenInfo:
Workers need a real assignment. A contractor's wage differs from an inmate's work credit, and neither automatically clears custody. Tools and materials are counted back at the end; a work order covers only its actual task. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

Authored contact: Masaru Hasebe is initially based at Prison Work Yard - Workshop. Use that existing individual when their role is relevant; introduce manageable groups and preserve actual subsequent travel or absence.

Prison Work Yard - Muster Point.description: Assignments, supervision, and tool lists are confirmed before work begins.

Prison Work Yard - Workshop.description: Safe approved repairs and maintenance use specifically issued equipment.

Prison Work Yard - Inspection Bench.description: Finished work is inspected and its actual payment or credit recorded.

Prison Stores.name: Prison Stores
Prison Stores.basicInfo: Provisions, linen, approved maintenance materials, and accounted tools are issued from a controlled stores building.
Prison Stores.hiddenInfo: Seals and counts provide evidence of handovers. Unclaimed goods remain prison or supplier property. A legitimate supply task does not authorize opening private property deposits or secured cells. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

Prison Stores - Issue Counter.description: Authorized requests identify the recipient, materials, and return conditions.

Prison Stores - Supply Room.description: Inspected loads and general provisions are organized separately from unresolved consignments.

Prison Stores - Tool Cage.description: Potentially dangerous tools are secured, issued by agreement, and checked on return.

Prison Infirmary.name: Prison Infirmary
Prison Infirmary.basicInfo:
A staffed treatment building handles injury, illness, and recovery for people within the prison campus.

Ena Minamori treats patients in the Treatment Room and insists that medical decisions follow the injury rather than somebody’s impatience.
Prison Infirmary.hiddenInfo: Treatment does not alter legal status. A knocked-out prisoner recovers under the same actual custody; confiscated belongings do not reappear as a fresh inventory. An urgent medical need can justify an actual escorted transfer without becoming automatic release. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

Prison Infirmary - Treatment Room.description: Routine and urgent medical care follows the actual condition.

Prison Infirmary - Recovery Ward.description: Patients rest with the supervision their actual legal status requires.

Prison Infirmary - Medicine Counter.description: Supplies and treatment records are controlled; medical care is not unlimited public stock.

Prison Visiting Hall.name: Prison Visiting Hall
Prison Visiting Hall.basicInfo: Approved visits and authorized interviews take place in a supervised hall with separate visitor and prisoner approaches.
Prison Visiting Hall.hiddenInfo: Visits can maintain relationships, convey permitted information, or support a real appeal. A visitor is not recruited, imprisoned, or granted access to the rest of the campus by arriving. Contraband and private information require actual handling rather than automatic discovery. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

Prison Visiting Hall - Visitor Reception.description: Staff verify the actual visit approval, identities, and restrictions.

Prison Visiting Hall - Meeting Room.description: Visits occur under stated supervision and communication limits.

Prison Visiting Hall - Interview Room.description: Authorized advocates and officials can hold a permitted case discussion.

Prison Mess Hall.name: Prison Mess Hall
Prison Mess Hall.basicInfo:
Prison meals and ordinary shared conversation take place in a supervised dining building.

Tobio Hanekawa is often at the dining tables, trying to make a rather unimpressed audience appreciate his latest story.
Prison Mess Hall.hiddenInfo: Food, routine, alliances, irritation, and small favors can matter without turning every diner into a mastermind. People know only what they have actually learned. Food is not withheld merely to manufacture drama. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

Prison Mess Hall - Serving Hall.description: Meals are distributed on the actual routine.

Prison Mess Hall - Dining Room.description: People may converse within the current supervision and access rules.

Prison Mess Hall - Kitchen Access.description: Food preparation and supply work require an actual authorized assignment.

Prison Exercise Yard.name: Prison Exercise Yard
Prison Exercise Yard.basicInfo: A contained outdoor exercise ground gives prisoners permitted space to move under supervision.
Prison Exercise Yard.hiddenInfo: Exercise, small competitions, and ordinary companionship provide activities beyond planning escape. Access to a wall does not settle its height, observation, wards, or the route beyond. Training does not automatically grant a new ability. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

Prison Exercise Yard - Exercise Ground.description: Open space supports permitted exercise and movement.

Prison Exercise Yard - Covered Benches.description: People rest, talk, or observe the yard within actual restrictions.

Prison Exercise Yard - Yard Gate.description: The supervised gate controls entry and exit.

Prison Security Headquarters.name: Prison Security Headquarters
Prison Security Headquarters.basicInfo:
Security staff coordinate escorts, incidents, shift coverage, and appropriate responses from a restricted command building.

Warden Shūgo Katase normally works from the Duty Desk and coordinates the custody staff.
Prison Security Headquarters.hiddenInfo: Officers act on reports and actual observations, not complete knowledge of the player. Alarm, investigation, lockdown, pursuit, and release are different decisions. Increasing security follows an actual cause; staff are trained and capable rather than invincible. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

Prison Security Headquarters - Duty Desk.description: Authorized movement, escort assignments, and routine reports are checked.

Prison Security Headquarters - Control R.description: Staff coordinate gates, signals, and recorded incidents using the information actually received.

Prison Security Headquarters - Guard Roo.description: On-duty personnel prepare and regroup. A uniform alone does not establish identity.

Prison Watchtowers.name: Prison Watchtowers
Prison Watchtowers.basicInfo: Elevated observation posts cover sea approaches, walls, and exposed routes around the secured campus.
Prison Watchtowers.hiddenInfo: Sightlines, weather, lighting, and shift coverage affect what a lookout can notice. An actual distraction or gap must be established rather than invented as guaranteed escape. The lookouts can call support but cannot observe through every wall. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

Prison Watchtowers - Tower Checkpoint.description: Restricted stairs begin behind an actual access check.

Prison Watchtowers - Lookout Platform.description: A staffed platform overlooks specified approaches and signals relevant observations.

Prison Watchtowers - Signal Post.description: Alarms communicate what was seen, with ordinary delays and possible uncertainty.

Prison Sea Wall.name: Prison Sea Wall
Prison Sea Wall.basicInfo: Sea-facing defenses separate controlled prison grounds from exposed rock and water. Walking routes and access gates are maintained under security rules.
Prison Sea Wall.hiddenInfo: The wall, sea conditions, observation, and transport are distinct obstacles. A successful escape must address the chosen route's actual problems. There is no guaranteed secret tunnel, forced recapture, or unexplained immunity to clever play. Movement between facilities must respect the actual authorized route, escorts, locked access, and current security. Knowing a facility's name does not permit entry.

Prison Sea Wall - Seaward Walk.description: A monitored route faces the water and exposed shore.

Prison Sea Wall - Maintenance Gate.description: Repairs require a real work order or another actually established route through secured access.

Prison Sea Wall - Rocky Foreshore.description: Exposed rock and water offer no automatic safe landing or boat. Physical access still requires resolving the defenses.

Drakenspire Portals.name: Drakenspire Portals
Drakenspire Portals.basicInfo:
Drakenspire's portalward quarter is the usual first stop in the snowy capital. An enclosed basalt transit hall opens into a compact market and communal hearth court; beyond them, steep lanes connect the lower city's homes and workshops. Above the roofs to the northeast, the fortress rises within the immense crescent of the ancestral dragon's bones. Travelers can arrange cargo, buy a hot meal, obtain directions and hear current road conditions before choosing where to go. This map location covers the arrival quarter; the wider city and nation also bear the name Drakenspire.

People associated with this place include: Fuyumi Kirihara — Portal arrivals clerk; Daigo Numata — Portal cargo porter.
Drakenspire Portals.hiddenInfo:
Local attendants handle passage and cargo, not the entire country's affairs. A disputed delivery order can delay one consignment without closing the portal. Existing authored or previously established people retain their identities; services need no invented famous official. Wild mountain creatures do not occupy the transit hall.

This location has one fixed return passage to Evertree Base - Portal Room. Entering that arch from any of its local staging areas completes the short approach and crossing; do not require the exact sub-area label. The player chooses whether to enter, not where in Glowhaven to land. No academy or second city portal exists.

Drakenspire - Portal Room.description: A warm vaulted basalt chamber encloses the permanent Glowhaven arch. Iron roof ribs, blue mineral veins and brass runic channels frame the crossing; frosted high windows reveal the weather. A duty desk and clear cargo floor leave passengers room to arrive. The fixed home connection returns to Evertree Base - Portal Room; its operation follows the existing route and key rules. Actual doors lead to the Cobbled Market, Hearth Court and Steep Lanes. Fuyumi Kirihara is usually based here, working as portal arrivals clerk.

Drakenspire - Cobbled Market.description: Low stone stalls shelter beneath striped wool awnings. Vendors sell travel food, crampon repairs and inexpensive gloves, while porters compare cargo slips. This is a small arrival market; the broader household trade happens at Hearthmarket Square. Displayed merchandise remains the vendors' property.

Drakenspire - Hearth Court.description: A hooded brazier warms a sheltered court with stone drains and benches cut to leave space for tails. Residents trade news beside posted local work. A traveler may eat, wait for a companion or ask directions without being drawn into an emergency.

Drakenspire - Steep Lanes.description: Steps and narrow ramps climb between dark stone houses with blue-gray roofs. Handcarts use the ramps; pedestrians yield at blind corners. The lanes lead into the lower city, while an uphill view repeatedly catches the fortress bones through gaps between chimneys.

Drakenspire - Cargo Recess.description: Iron floor rings and numbered chalk bays keep freight clear of the portal. Attendants compare declared loads with their documents before release. A torn packing label may require the owner to identify a crate; opening it or taking its contents is a separate matter. Daigo Numata is usually based here, working as portal cargo porter.

Embersteel Foundries.name: Embersteel Foundries
Embersteel Foundries.basicInfo:
A connected group of working foundries turns mountain ore into dependable metal stock, tools and substantial commissioned work. Soot-dark stone, extraction chimneys and sheltered loading courts make the district feel industrial without requiring every machine to be magical. Customers arrange specifications in the Commission Hall before entering supervised work areas. Drakenspire's reputation for metallurgy rests on skilled labor, careful testing and materials knowledge. The foundries supply smaller specialist workshops as well as larger orders, so a commission may involve several businesses rather than one master who does everything.

People associated with this place include: Chisato Higuruma — Embersteel foundry forewoman.
Embersteel Foundries.hiddenInfo: A questionable batch, delayed fuel or changed specification can create practical conflict. Testing must establish whether the fault lies in metal, design or use; a visible crack is not proof of sabotage. Skilled work takes agreed time and materials, and commissioned stock remains its owner's property.

Embersteel Foundries - Commission Hall.description: Sample bars and finished fittings line a high room separated from the furnaces. Clerks and craftspeople translate intended use into a specification and quote. Customers can discuss repairs or deliveries without wandering into active metalworking.

Embersteel Foundries - Forge Walk.description: A protected walkway overlooks furnaces, hammers and crews handling bright metal. Heat, noise and moving loads demand attention. Visitors remain in marked safe spaces unless an actual supervised task takes them onto the working floor. Chisato Higuruma is usually based here, working as embersteel foundry forewoman.

Embersteel Foundries - Testing Court.description: A walled court holds measured loads, impact blocks and quenching stations for appropriate inspections. Tests answer a specific question about a real workpiece. Watching a demonstration does not grant the observer the item or its properties.

Embersteel Foundries - Materials Yard.description: Sheltered bays separate ore, scrap, fuel and finished stock. Weight slips accompany substantial deliveries. A mismatched label or poor storage can cause an expensive problem before any metal reaches a furnace.

Embersteel Foundries - Repair Bay.description: A quieter side bay receives damaged tools and machinery fittings. Workers separate straightforward maintenance from faults needing specialist enchantment work. Repairs are assessed, agreed and carried out rather than completed by merely discussing them.

Stonefang Training Grounds.name: Stonefang Training Grounds
Stonefang Training Grounds.basicInfo:
Stonefang provides supervised practice space for local fighters, guards on arranged sessions and visitors seeking instruction. It is a training ground rather than a large magical university. Its open ring, stone steps and equipment shelter support drills, sparring and practical evaluation. The ground welcomes different methods when they can be used safely in the available space; spectacular magic is not automatically suitable. Lessons and partnerships depend on the actual instructor or participant, with room for ordinary repetition and imperfect progress.

People associated with this place include: Ryōma Arashimine — Clan Arashimine heir and commissioned duelist; Tetsuya Samejima — Stonefang instructor.
Stonefang Training Grounds.hiddenInfo: The grounds should not become a second public fight pit. A visitor may arrange instruction without enrolling in a new academy or receiving a free ability. Instructors can explain risk and stop unsafe practice while remaining distinct from military command.

Stonefang Training Grounds - Open Ring.description: A cleared ring accommodates supervised drills and agreed sparring. Marked edges help participants judge distance. Entering it does not start combat until the people involved have agreed what they are doing. Ryōma Arashimine is usually based here, working as clan arashimine heir and commissioned duelist.

Stonefang Training Grounds - Stone Steps.description: Broad steps beside the ring serve as seats and places to discuss a technique. Observers can watch without joining. A patient explanation or useful correction can be more valuable than another exhibition of strength.

Stonefang Training Grounds - Equipment S.description: Maintained practice gear is stored under a deep roof. Items are issued for actual sessions and checked on return. Visitors do not own a weapon merely because they have been allowed to train with it.

Stonefang Training Grounds - Target Lane.description: A screened lane permits suitable ranged practice with clear firing and retrieval periods. Distance and backstops constrain safe techniques. Spells that exceed the facility's limits require another venue, not an implausibly indestructible wall. Tetsuya Samejima is usually based here, working as stonefang instructor.

Stonefang Training Grounds - Balance Cou.description: Low beams and uneven stone blocks support controlled footwork drills. Snow and ice are cleared or deliberately accounted for. The course builds practical movement without being a lethal obstacle gauntlet.

Whitepass Caravan Lodge.name: Whitepass Caravan Lodge
Whitepass Caravan Lodge.basicInfo:
A substantial lodge near the overland approach accommodates carriers, expedition parties and visitors who need more than a quick meal. Its common hearth, route desk and covered yard connect lodging with practical travel preparation. Rooms are sturdy and warm rather than luxurious, and staff understand drying gear, early departures and delayed companions. The lodge is a useful base for mountain work without making every guest a guide or every rumor a contract. Returning safely can be reason enough for an uneventful evening here.

People associated with this place include: Natsume Hibari — Licensed mountain adventurer and expedition guide; Akemi Fushida — Proprietor of Whitepass Caravan Lodge.

Whitepass Drying-Loft Room is available by agreement: 28 marks for the quoted paid stay. Ask Akemi Fushida to inspect it and confirm the actual terms before paying.
Whitepass Caravan Lodge.hiddenInfo:
A late caravan is not automatically destroyed; check weather and actual reports. Staff can recommend services without guaranteeing a guide's availability. Paid rooms and stored belongings remain distinct from party recruitment, permanent residence or unrestricted access to another guest's luggage.

PROPERTY TERMS: Whitepass Drying-Loft Room has a fixed opening quote of 28 marks. Its native transaction supplies the key/deed and removes that price once when the owner agrees and the player explicitly commits. Do not also charge or grant it through item generation. A quote, viewing or gift of a key does not silently transfer ownership. Rentals cover the agreed stay, have no background rent drain and need a fresh agreement for an extension; purchases are permanent modest property with no automatic income or free specialist stock. Unavailable sold property is not offered to a second unrelated buyer. Ordinary room access stays local.

Authored contact: Daigo Kisaragi is initially based at Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Common Hearth. Use that existing individual when their role is relevant; introduce manageable groups and preserve actual subsequent travel or absence.

Authored contact: Chisato Akamine is initially based at Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Covered Yard. Use that existing individual when their role is relevant; introduce manageable groups and preserve actual subsequent travel or absence.

Authored contact: Tomoe Inukai is initially based at Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Route Desk. Use that existing individual when their role is relevant; introduce manageable groups and preserve actual subsequent travel or absence.

Authored contact: Gaku Shindō is initially based at Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Common Hearth. Use that existing individual when their role is relevant; introduce manageable groups and preserve actual subsequent travel or absence.

Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Common Hearth.description: Long tables surround a broad hearth where wet clothing dries at a sensible distance. Guests eat stew, trade road news or sit quietly. A returning party can celebrate without the room producing a new emergency on cue. Akemi Fushida is usually based here, working as proprietor of whitepass caravan lodge.

Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Route Desk.description: A desk holds copied route notes, local notices and contacts for transport. Advice distinguishes maintained paths from uncertain reports. Staff can help arrange a service, but they cannot promise that a high pass is safe in changing weather. Natsume Hibari is usually based here, working as licensed mountain adventurer and expedition guide.

Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Covered Yard.description: Pack animals and carts shelter beneath deep eaves. Tie rails, repair blocks and water access support real travel work. Loads remain in their owners' custody, and animals are handled with permission.

Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Guest Landing.description: Simple private rooms open from a warm upper corridor. Quiet hours and paid arrangements keep tired travelers from disturbing one another. A closed door is not an invitation to inspect someone else's belongings.
paths: Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Whitepass Drying-Loft Room

Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Drying Room.description: Racks and controlled warmth dry boots, cloaks and ropes without scorching them. Labels prevent accidental swaps. Damaged gear can be noticed here before another journey, creating a practical reason to visit an outfitter.

Whitepass Caravan Lodge - Whitepass Dryi.description: A warm private room with a sturdy bed, gear hooks and a shuttered mountain window above the lodge drying loft.

Rimecrest Trail.name: Rimecrest Trail
Rimecrest Trail.basicInfo: A marked highland trail provides the most approachable excursion beyond the capital's immediate roads. It crosses exposed ridges, sheltered turns and places used for route and weather surveys. Prepared travelers can practice navigation, observe local ecology or carry out authorized fieldwork without immediately entering the deepest monster territory. The views are wide, but conditions can change quickly. Marker Ridge, Windbreak Shelter and Survey Shelf are established stops; pushing beyond the maintained route is a separate decision.
Rimecrest Trail.hiddenInfo: The trail offers lower-risk fieldwork, not guaranteed safety. A leaning marker or new drift can make a familiar route harder to read. Observations only count toward an expedition when the actual assignment and recorded work support them; arriving here alone is not completion.

Rimecrest Trail - Marker Ridge.description: Weathered poles mark the maintained route along a broad ridge. The city remains visible in clear weather, while cloud can erase it within minutes. Travelers compare markers and footing before continuing instead of following every apparent track.

Rimecrest Trail - Windbreak Shelter.description: A low stone shelter holds a bench, a protected floor and a notice recess. It is a temporary refuge, not a staffed inn or limitless supply cache. A previous traveler may have left a useful dated warning.

Rimecrest Trail - Survey Shelf.description: A stable shelf overlooks slope, snowpack and distant animal routes. It suits careful observation and agreed field measurements. Leaving equipment or collecting specimens requires the same judgment and permissions as any actual expedition.

Rimecrest Trail - Return Junction.description: A marked junction points toward the lower approach and more demanding routes. Signs summarize destinations, not current certainty. Turning back here is a normal choice when visibility, gear or time makes further travel unwise.

Cloudbloom Landing.name: Cloudbloom Landing
Cloudbloom Landing.basicInfo:
The archipelago’s sheltered arrival and freight terrace occupies the settlement satellite near Asterveil Canopy. Its enclosed whitewood-and-glass Portal Room opens onto a railed quay, receiving counter and waiting space. Court-authorized visitors can return directly to Glowhaven, arrange a local crossing, check weather reports or move agreed cargo. A visitor does not need wings or a new spell to travel.

ROUTES: Asterveil Canopy: a short maintained walk on the settlement satellite; Bellwind Conservatory: the cooperative’s attended central-island crossing; Tetherroot Chain: a short carrier route with stops at actual moorings; Rimeglass Refuge: the attended northeastern carrier crossing. A sky gap requires the stated actual crossing; nearby map pins do not imply connected ground.
Cloudbloom Landing.hiddenInfo:
Keep this a usable safe hub. Porters, crossing crews and officials are generated only as needed and remain the same individuals on later visits. Transit permission does not authorize wildlife capture. A damaged freight sling can delay one shipment without closing the portal or inventing a realm-wide disaster.

LOCAL SPECIES: No mandatory wild encounter inside the maintained hub. Reuse these exact npcTypes when the actual encounter fits. A type is not an automatic spawn. Make a persistent individual with this location’s band, real disposition and bounded abilities; retain custom diagnostic anatomy in its actual public visual description. Cleared or avoided encounters keep their real outcome. When the player deliberately enters occupied hunting ground, resolve a real encounter rather than presenting signs indefinitely.

This location has one fixed return passage to Evertree Base - Portal Room. Entering that arch from any of its local staging areas completes the short approach and crossing; do not require the exact sub-area label. The player chooses whether to enter, not where in Glowhaven to land. No academy or second city portal exists.

LOCAL SAFETY: The maintained receiving room, settlement interior or refuge is not an ambient hunting ground. Wildlife danger belongs beyond its actual boundaries. Existing conflict and consequences of deliberate hostile acts remain real; ordinary rest, service or conversation does not summon a monster.

Additional local creature possibility: Cloudveil Nautilus. Use an actual appropriate individual only in a fitting occupied habitat or current problem. Safe services remain safe; this is not a mandatory spawn. Follow this location's level band and the least experienced human's ordinary-work risk, with warning before a deliberate harder undertaking.

Cloudbloom Landing - Portal Room.description: A sheltered oval chamber of pale stone and living whitewood receives portal travelers before the outside terrace. Curved translucent panes hold back the high wind; woven flowering branches support a pearl-lit ceiling. The local arch sits within a braided wood-and-crystal ring, with soft chimes and a shallow basin of drifting petals marking its settled rhythm. A modest duty counter and clear waiting space serve passengers without blocking the route. The fixed return connects directly to Evertree Base - Portal Room in Glowhaven. Doorways lead to the Arrival Terrace and Crossing Quay; the sky, gardens and cloud sea become an outside view rather than an automatic new landing.

Cloudbloom Landing - Arrival Terrace.description: Low rails, flowering planters and a clear sky view welcome arriving travelers. Ordinary arrival can be peaceful.

Cloudbloom Landing - Crossing Quay.description:
Attended local transport and connected walks are arranged here. Establish the actual available route; a cloud gap is not walkable ground.

Kohane Kazahana is the regular carrier pilot based here. Her real sail carrier, weather checks and scheduled loads provide departures; a social conversation does not purchase a flight or recruit her.

Cloudbloom Landing - Freight Shelter.description: Covered racks keep consignments separate from passengers. Tags identify owner, destination and handling terms. A carrier may need an extra pair of hands securing an awkward crate; the crate remains the consignor’s property.

Cloudbloom Landing - Route Counter.description:
A board records current practical routes and actual weather closures. The crossing cooperative can quote a fare or charter, identify a grounded return plan and explain where the next refuge is. Passage is agreed before payment.

Kohane Kazahana handles agreed routes when not piloting. The public counter can accept a message during a flight; do not invent a second permanent route captain to replace her.

Asterveil Canopy.name: Asterveil Canopy
Asterveil Canopy.basicInfo:
A small fae settlement curls around flowering trees on a protected satellite. Homes, a modest market, guest rooms and shared work terraces form one neighborhood rather than a sprawling capital. Residents cultivate food and fragrances, maintain transport and outfit expeditions. Human-scale visitors fit the main walks; smaller personal dwellings remain private.

ROUTES: Cloudbloom Landing: a short maintained walk on the settlement satellite. A sky gap requires the stated actual crossing; nearby map pins do not imply connected ground.

Canopy Guest Bough is available by agreement: 24 marks for the quoted paid stay. Ask Yuzuri Takase to inspect it and confirm the actual terms before paying.
Asterveil Canopy.hiddenInfo:
The local assembly appoints rotating stewards for water, crossings and habitat agreements. A practical argument over damaged pollen screens can become a repair, negotiation or compensation task. Do not make every resident welcoming, coy or secretly ancient royalty. Residents have ordinary work and can refuse a bad commission.

LOCAL SPECIES: No mandatory wild encounter inside the maintained hub. Reuse these exact npcTypes when the actual encounter fits. A type is not an automatic spawn. Make a persistent individual with this location’s band, real disposition and bounded abilities; retain custom diagnostic anatomy in its actual public visual description. Cleared or avoided encounters keep their real outcome. When the player deliberately enters occupied hunting ground, resolve a real encounter rather than presenting signs indefinitely.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: A Road Made of Air: The Far End; The Hunt That Looks Back: A Shape in the Wake; First Bloom, Last Rehearsal; A Voice Below the Roots; What the Manta Leaves; The Room Below the Ring; An Impossible Shade of Green; Two Teams, One Clean Sample. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

LOCAL SAFETY: The maintained receiving room, settlement interior or refuge is not an ambient hunting ground. Wildlife danger belongs beyond its actual boundaries. Existing conflict and consequences of deliberate hostile acts remain real; ordinary rest, service or conversation does not summon a monster.

CATALOGUE SUPPLY CONTEXT: Appropriate ordinary or specialist stock can include Sky-Silk Thread Bundle; Dewglass Resin Cake; Cloudfield Observation Atlas; Bellwind Promise Cord; Lantern-Moss Pellet; Living-Specimen Wardbox. These are exact itemTypes identities, not already granted items or guaranteed unlimited stock. Present a few relevant goods when browsing or a supply request actually happens, with real payment and ownership. Visiting does not buy anything. Rare teaching scrolls may enter a genuine specialist collection or discovery; do not place every scroll in every shop.

PROPERTY TERMS: Canopy Guest Bough has a fixed opening quote of 24 marks. Its native transaction supplies the key/deed and removes that price once when the owner agrees and the player explicitly commits. Do not also charge or grant it through item generation. A quote, viewing or gift of a key does not silently transfer ownership. Rentals cover the agreed stay, have no background rent drain and need a fresh agreement for an extension; purchases are permanent modest property with no automatic income or free specialist stock. Unavailable sold property is not offered to a second unrelated buyer. Ordinary room access stays local.

Authored contact: Suzuha Midorise is initially based at Asterveil Canopy - Field Registry. Use that existing individual when their role is relevant; introduce manageable groups and preserve actual subsequent travel or absence.

Asterveil Canopy - Canopy Walk.description: A stable walk threads between homes and flowering branches. It is a neighborhood route, not an open invitation into private rooms.

Asterveil Canopy - Petal Market.description:
Fragrances, local produce and useful small craft are traded through actual quotes and transactions.

Rento Tobari takes repair enquiries at his nearby workshop; Honoka Hazukawa buys ingredients. Household stalls can use incidental vendors without replacing these established businesses.

Asterveil Canopy - Guest Terrace.description:
A sheltered public terrace permits conversation, directions and meetings without obliging a visitor to stay overnight.

Honoka Hazukawa serves meals here, and Yuzuri Takase often enjoys games or unhurried company. Their presence follows their actual work and choices rather than a compulsory daily quest.

Asterveil Canopy - Field Registry.description:
A public desk accepts survey proposals and posts finite local contracts. The duty registrar records an agreed site, methods, collection limit, return contact and fee. This is a local service, not another magical academy or an automatic court-authorization office.

Sakuya Tomonari coordinates local commissions and accepts agreed reports, including work relayed for the cooperative or conservatory. He directs specific technical questions to Kohane Kazahana or Kureha Kazahana rather than claiming to know every discipline.

Asterveil Canopy - Guest Boughs.description:
A compact guesthouse offers meals, a bed, storage and a shared table after an actual quote. Rooms suit different bodies without making every fae tiny. Privacy and settled bills persist.

Honoka Hazukawa keeps the rooms. Yuzuri Takase is a paying guest, with her own plans and leisure; a request for help can be accepted or refused. Introduce them individually according to the scene.

Asterveil Canopy - Menders Terrace.description:
Workers repair harnesses, nets, weather cloth and casting tools with actual materials and time. Expeditioners can commission equipment or examine damage brought back from the field.

Rento Tobari works here. He inspects the actual fault and quotes the agreed repair; the customer retains ownership of entrusted equipment.

Asterveil Canopy - Stewards Hall.description:
A plain communal room serves hearings, permits and practical decisions. A rotating office holder can hear evidence and issue a bounded local collection permit; this is not unlimited ownership of the wilderness.

Sakuya Tomonari attends household hearings during his current rotation. He represents agreed local duties and can be challenged by residents; he is neither a king nor a court official from Glowhaven.

Asterveil Canopy - Kitchen Gardens.description: Food beds, herbs and rain jars support the small community. A short shift, a shared meal or a quiet afternoon can be a complete visit. The plants are cultivated property rather than free expedition supplies.

Asterveil Canopy - Canopy Guest Bough.description: A private guest bough with an adjustable sleeping nook, sheltered work shelf and space for ordinary luggage.

Bellwind Conservatory.name: Bellwind Conservatory
Bellwind Conservatory.basicInfo:
Tended test gardens spread across a broad forest terrace, with a modest conservatory and exposed measuring stations. Bellwind studies island plants, pollinators, weather and useful mana-bearing materials. Visitors can compare specimens, obtain a collection protocol or help with a defined trial. The site includes working terrain; its workrooms are areas within one location.

ROUTES: Cloudbloom Landing: the cooperative’s attended central-island crossing; Mythwing Meadows: a marked meadow route; Petalwash Terraces: a streamside field path. A sky gap requires the stated actual crossing; nearby map pins do not imply connected ground.
Bellwind Conservatory.hiddenInfo:
Several strips of pollination cloth are coming back cut in neat parallel lines. A Threadwing Grazer migration rather than sabotage explains the damage. Compare undamaged controls and fresh fibers before treating the crop. Burning the beds destroys both evidence and useful stock. Properly collected data can close the matter without a fight.

LOCAL SPECIES: Threadwing Grazer; Petalglass Snail. Reuse these exact npcTypes when the actual encounter fits. A type is not an automatic spawn. Make a persistent individual with this location’s band, real disposition and bounded abilities; retain custom diagnostic anatomy in its actual public visual description. Cleared or avoided encounters keep their real outcome. When the player deliberately enters occupied hunting ground, resolve a real encounter rather than presenting signs indefinitely.

LOCAL SAFETY: The maintained receiving room, settlement interior or refuge is not an ambient hunting ground. Wildlife danger belongs beyond its actual boundaries. Existing conflict and consequences of deliberate hostile acts remain real; ordinary rest, service or conversation does not summon a monster.

Bellwind Conservatory - Living Gallery.description:
Tended plants grow along labeled work bays. Existing knowledge and observed results govern an examination.

Kureha Kazahana is the resident cultivator and field ecologist. Her argument with Kohane Kazahana is familiar local comedy, not evidence that the sisters hate each other.

Bellwind Conservatory - Wind Platform.description: A railed platform allows observation of currents and changing island conditions without requiring the visitor to fly.

Bellwind Conservatory - Cultivation Room.description: Tools, cuttings and work records support agreed garden tasks. Avoid inventing a dangerous secret for every experiment.

Bellwind Conservatory - Control Beds.description:
Matching plots differ in only one treatment. Tags and intact controls let a patient visitor distinguish insect feeding, weather abrasion and actual magical effects. Cutting random plants spoils the comparison.

Kureha Kazahana runs the living trials. Jianyu Wen visits for comparisons and can disagree with her on evidence without either becoming a new villain.

Bellwind Conservatory - Pollen Screens.description: Suspended fine cloth catches pollen and grazing fibers. Threadwing Grazers leave comb-like cuts and shed harmless iridescent scales. Wind shifts can carry the same evidence across neighboring plots.

Bellwind Conservatory - Specimen Porch.description:
Worktables, sealed jars and wash basins support permission-based comparison. A researcher can receive a documented sample without absorbing it, granting a spell or making a magical cure from appearance alone.

Kureha Kazahana handles sample discussions and the commission Cuts Among the Pollen. Registry work relayed by Sakuya Tomonari keeps its actual agreement and report requirements.

Mythwing Meadows.name: Mythwing Meadows
Mythwing Meadows.basicInfo:
A meadow basin and adjacent nesting shelves form a lightly managed wildlife buffer. Keepers maintain an observation verge and safe approach but do not control every creature. Visitors can count nesting activity, track a migration, gather permitted shed material or resolve a real conflict at the habitat edge.

ROUTES: Bellwind Conservatory: a marked meadow route. A sky gap requires the stated actual crossing; nearby map pins do not imply connected ground.
Mythwing Meadows.hiddenInfo:
Threadwing Grazers and ordinary grazers share the open ground; an occasional Griffin hunts beyond the managed boundary. A nest is occupied only when actually established. A hungry predator can be diverted from livestock without becoming tame. Never treat every wing, egg or animal as ownerless loot.

LOCAL SPECIES: Threadwing Grazer; Griffin; Cockatrice. Reuse these exact npcTypes when the actual encounter fits. A type is not an automatic spawn. Make a persistent individual with this location’s band, real disposition and bounded abilities; retain custom diagnostic anatomy in its actual public visual description. Cleared or avoided encounters keep their real outcome. When the player deliberately enters occupied hunting ground, resolve a real encounter rather than presenting signs indefinitely.

LOCAL EXPLORATION: These species occupy their actual habitat, not the map journey alone. Use the current room’s terrain and the site’s existing hunting, nesting, feeding or guardian situation. Investigating an occupied threat area can bring an actual finite individual or small group into contact through ordinary NPC generation; do not spend every visit only hinting at tracks. Grazers, neutral wildlife and resting creatures need not attack. Keep known identities and resolved outcomes. At a uniquely described guardian site, use that single resident instead of adding a second boss or replacement waves. Sheltered/rest areas remain usable once immediate threats are handled.

Mythwing Meadows - Observation Verge.description: A marked verge gives a view of the meadow without entering occupied nesting ground.

Mythwing Meadows - Sheltered Meadow.description: A broad grassy bowl is protected from the strongest wind. Creature behavior follows the actual animal or mana beast involved.

Mythwing Meadows - Keeper Station.description:
A sheltered station holds habitat notes, observation equipment and records of permitted visits. Keepers explain the local precautions and receive useful observations.

Hotone Mizuhane maintains hides and nesting observations here. Her summoned scout is a temporary construct; the wild grazers and nesting animals remain independent creatures.

Mythwing Meadows - Grazing Bowl.description: Low flowering grass reveals feeding trails and seasonal movement. Soft ground records real tracks; an observer can work from cover rather than charge into the herd.

Mythwing Meadows - Nesting Shelves.description: Wind-sheltered rock shelves overlook the basin. Approach noise and silhouette matter around occupied nests. Shed feathers can be collected only within the agreed habitat rules.

Mythwing Meadows - Return Hide.description:
A low observation shelter offers a covered rest and a view back toward the keeper station. It is a genuine retreat point, not a mandatory ambush or a monster respawn room.

This is Orivelle’s first stop in its observed four-day feeding circuit. Its visits are intermittent; old tracks and local rumor do not establish that it is here now.

Broken Halo Ruins.name: Broken Halo Ruins
Broken Halo Ruins.basicInfo:
Weathered pale-stone arcs lie among conifer roots on an eastern plateau. The ruined installation once measured currents rather than controlled the entire archipelago. Surveys compare inscriptions, erosion and surviving instruments. Its outer court, sheltered work space and undercroft form one site.

ROUTES: Frostbell Pines: an old stone survey approach; Thunderwake Crags: a local carrier crossing to the eastern crags. A sky gap requires the stated actual crossing; nearby map pins do not imply connected ground.
Broken Halo Ruins.hiddenInfo:
A damaged counterweight gives the outer ring a misleading tilt. Correct measurements can distinguish structural movement from an active magical effect. Hushbell Carapaces occupy the undercroft; their clickless approach and hanging oval shells are physical clues. Repairing access, documenting loss or recovering a permitted small component are all possible outcomes.

LOCAL SPECIES: Hushbell Carapace; Rune Sentinel. Reuse these exact npcTypes when the actual encounter fits. A type is not an automatic spawn. Make a persistent individual with this location’s band, real disposition and bounded abilities; retain custom diagnostic anatomy in its actual public visual description. Cleared or avoided encounters keep their real outcome. When the player deliberately enters occupied hunting ground, resolve a real encounter rather than presenting signs indefinitely.

LOCAL EXPLORATION: These species occupy their actual habitat, not the map journey alone. Use the current room’s terrain and the site’s existing hunting, nesting, feeding or guardian situation. Investigating an occupied threat area can bring an actual finite individual or small group into contact through ordinary NPC generation; do not spend every visit only hinting at tracks. Grazers, neutral wildlife and resting creatures need not attack. Keep known identities and resolved outcomes. At a uniquely described guardian site, use that single resident instead of adding a second boss or replacement waves. Sheltered/rest areas remain usable once immediate threats are handled.

Broken Halo Ruins - Survey Approach.description: An established approach ends at a marked survey boundary. Broken ground beyond needs an actual safe plan.
paths: Broken Halo Ruins - Fallen Arc Court

Broken Halo Ruins - Fallen Arc Court.description: Fallen stone arcs and shallow weathered carvings offer material for careful observation and measurement.

Broken Halo Ruins - Conservation Shelter.description:
A modest shelter holds work surfaces for agreed documentation. No hidden treasure or new escape route is guaranteed.

Jianyu Wen uses this existing shelter as his expedition base. His plumb frame, sketch leaves and correspondence make a working research site rather than a new academy or a claim to own the ruins.
paths: Broken Halo Ruins - Fallen Arc Court

Broken Halo Ruins - Undercroft.description: Low passages beneath the arcs contain old counterweights and nesting Hushbell Carapaces. Their dorsal cups absorb nearby noise, leaving patches of unnatural quiet rather than turning the entire ruin silent.

Broken Halo Ruins - Instrument Dais.description: Surviving slots show the position of missing measuring pieces. A reliable drawing can be useful without taking the remaining apparatus.

Silken Portal Room.name: Silken Portal Room
Silken Portal Room.basicInfo: A silver-edged return arch stands in a circular stone chamber beneath thick roots. Its pale light reveals soot-free flagstones, old cargo grooves and frayed silver lines caught in the masonry. The room is quiet enough to hear water falling far below. A stair leaves the protected arrival floor for Threadfall Galleries; the arch returns directly to Glowhaven without requiring investigation or victory.
Silken Portal Room.hiddenInfo:
The stable home arch is not the experimental web-anchor. Neither the matron’s survival nor a missing trophy can shut it. The key manifests through the existing first-arrival mechanism and stays reusable. This chamber is a regrouping refuge: no hostile creature spawns on the arrival floor and no mandatory combat interrupts immediate retreat. Old crate runners and a bronze depth marker show that the galleries once served movement of material, not a prophecy. Loose instruments may be examined as evidence, but examining does not automatically add inventory. The single physical route down takes a short stair into Threadfall Galleries. A map click on a deeper chamber cannot bypass the connecting rooms.

This location has one fixed return passage to Evertree Base - Portal Room. Entering that arch from any of its local staging areas completes the short approach and crossing; do not require the exact sub-area label. The player chooses whether to enter, not where in Glowhaven to land. No academy or second city portal exists.

The protected portal floor remains a refuge. Existing dungeon packs elsewhere determine their own finite occupancy; local scene elaboration does not add extra spiders to cleared rooms or the arrival floor.

Silken Portal Room - Return Arch.description: A stable silver aperture shows the Evertree Portal Room beyond its frame. Wind stirs loose threads toward home; the return surface stays clear even when the lower web lattice vibrates. Stepping through is ordinary whole-party return travel, not a locked reward.

Silken Portal Room - Arrival Floor.description: A broad circle of dry flagstones gives a traveling party room to count companions, check injuries and compare observations. Root shadows cross a worn cargo track. Nothing on this floor requires a spell, fee or fight before retreat.

Silken Portal Room - Descent Stair.description: A carved stair winds below a cracked bronze depth marker. Blue fungus outlines the first landing; beyond it, Threadfall Galleries opens around a hanging bridge. The stair is a real two-way passage, and a returning group can follow its own marks.

Threadfall Galleries.name: Threadfall Galleries
Threadfall Galleries.basicInfo: The first chamber opens around a stone island hung above a dark shaft. A pale web bridge shivers between broken abutments; blue-green fungus lights thick load-bearing strands and the dry shells caught beneath them. A lower stair can be seen across the gap. Narrow molting alcoves offer a cramped alternative around one wall. Small sounds carry through the silk before they reach the ear.
Threadfall Galleries.hiddenInfo: CHALLENGE: Establish a viable route to the Lower Stair. The main bridge is supported by three visible tension bundles; a sagging middle line makes a careless rush dangerous. Deliberate anchoring, testing the loaded strands, a resolved flight or movement technique, or following the molting alcove detour can work. The detour has a brittle lip to test or brace. No specific affinity or kill is mandatory. Describe warning movement before a check; a failed attempt has a bounded consequence and leaves another approach or retreat. Three separate native packs occupy the entry walk, main bridge and molting detour. Use the area-entry triggers, existing npcTypes and actual runtime identities and individual health; no prose-only replacement spider or endless wave. Avoiding or displacing it can suffice. The Dry Survey Ledge offers rest once immediate threats are handled. Molting shells reveal a repeated movement pattern and rubbed bronze clips point to deliberate rigging below. Successful passage opens Sunken Broodworks through the route trigger; merely reaching an area label or saying the bridge is safe does not. Once established, the crossing stays usable for return and later visits.

Threadfall Galleries - Upper Walk.description: The entry ledge overlooks the bridge and its lower-stair destination. Three bundled strands hum at different pitches when disturbed. There is space to watch the crossing, establish an anchor or retreat up the portal stair before committing weight.

Threadfall Galleries - Tension Crossing.description: The bridge mixes old stone slabs with taut living silk over a visible drop. Its middle span sags before it fails; vibrations warn the resident spider of heavy movement. Reaching the far abutment requires an actual safe method, not a sentence of offscreen success.

Threadfall Galleries - Molting Alcoves.description: Dry recesses curl around the left wall behind translucent discarded shells. Rubbed marks show how the spider uses them to avoid the bridge. The low route is narrow rather than secret; its brittle lip can be probed, braced or bypassed by a real technique.

Threadfall Galleries - Dry Survey Ledge.description: A sheltered shelf overlooks the main strands without touching them. Dust preserves the outlines of removed cargo baskets. Here the party can sketch the support pattern, compare shed silk and rest after dealing with any nearby threat. The room does not heal resources by itself.

Threadfall Galleries - Lower Stair.description: A split stair runs down the right wall toward a deeper pool of turquoise light. Bronze clips lead the eye to repaired machinery below. The approved route continues into Sunken Broodworks across the map seam; this landing is not another map location.

Sunken Broodworks.name: Sunken Broodworks
Sunken Broodworks.basicInfo: The second chamber is a flooded workshop of low stone platforms, bronze winches and silver-draped arches. Water turns slowly beneath a guarded span; intact gears pulse when strands tighten somewhere below. Beyond a wall of geometric thread marks, a dense lattice screens the matron’s gate. The air smells of damp mineral and warm metal. The descent continues here, rather than opening into another dungeon or settlement.
Sunken Broodworks.hiddenInfo: CHALLENGE: Secure the Guarded Span or a real alternative and make the Matron Gate passable. Three arachne span defenders work together, a spider pack occupies the Lower Winch and two gatekeepers hold the Matron Gate. Use the type-based area-entry encounters and their actual runtime identities, distinct from Vhalessra. Each group can be fought, distracted, credibly negotiated past where sapient, or actually bypassed. Preserve individual states and do not pull every group into one encounter. The Lower Winch controls a tension cradle, not a magical password. The Pattern Wall shows matching three-part load marks: observe the pulse, release the cradle between pulses and pin the slack line. Sound reasoning, careful tools, Force or suitable learned magic can implement a viable method. Severing a live bundle carelessly risks a visible recoil; attempting it still requires an outcome. A real safe alternate around the lattice also qualifies. Do not require every side area or every enemy death. The Rest Ledge permits observation from cover. Experimental anchor filaments and a piece of foreign transit metal establish how the apparatus snagged another route, not that the Evertree is dying. Actual secured passage opens Widow’s Crucible permanently; no reset on return.

Sunken Broodworks - Water Shelf.description: The upper stair ends above ankle-deep mineral water. Ripples reveal the patrol’s approach before its legs reach the platforms. Raised stones offer a dry staging point and a clear path back; the first chamber remains immediately up the stairs.

Sunken Broodworks - Guarded Span.description: A narrow platform crosses the turning water toward the main winch. Silver trip-lines show where the broodwarden watches. The water’s reflection and its actual patrol rhythm may support distraction or evasion; combat does not start with unavoidable damage.

Sunken Broodworks - Lower Winch.description: A bronze drum winds three lines around a stone cradle. A worn handle and locking pin are usable physical mechanisms. Turning against a loaded pulse is difficult; observing the Pattern Wall or supporting the cradle can make the same work manageable.

Sunken Broodworks - Rest Ledge.description: A dry recess behind a split pillar hides the party from the span without erasing its noises or scent. Old silk samples cling to matching load marks. A narrow lip reaches the Pattern Wall if it is actually traversed; it is an alternative approach, not an instant teleport.

Sunken Broodworks - Pattern Wall.description: Three repeated marks show a load cradle rising, slackening and being pinned. New silver strands run over much older carved instructions. Studying this tangible sequence can support a workable gate method; copying symbols alone does not solve the machinery. Deeper impressions show a much larger body and old spear impacts from the queen’s guard; heat has blistered the lower metal. These are warnings of a substantially stronger defended chamber, not a promise of a fair solo duel.

Sunken Broodworks - Matron Gate.description: A curtain of taut silver lattice fills the narrow descent into the warm crucible. Slackening and securing the line, or resolving another viable access method, makes it a stable two-way route. Beyond it stands the actual matron’s chamber; there is no second queen behind a hidden deeper door.

Widow's Crucible.name: Widow's Crucible
Widow's Crucible.basicInfo: The lowest chamber is a circular crucible of dark stone, ember-lit vents and silver anchor lines. Thick pillars divide an outer ring from a raised weaving dais. Vhalessra intercepts humanoid outsiders here with open hostility, using the chamber’s strands and sight lines to defend her apparatus. A broken cradle behind the dais gathers the converging threads. The stairs back remain real and usable.
Widow's Crucible.hiddenInfo:
Use the sole authored boss Vhalessra, level 45, initial relationship -85. The entry trigger brings her to the actual arrival area after the lower passage is earned; do not replace her with a generated queen. She blocks, threatens and attacks intruders who press on, but an actual defense, retreat or credible parley is possible. Raised ribs and pillars provide real cover; heated vents give visible warnings before a hazardous maneuver. Her Nature and Fire magic and learned techniques govern the encounter, with no arbitrary immunity or second phase. The central web-anchor is her experiment for reaching beyond the chasm; a damaged foreign transit fitting and strain scars corroborate the accidental route snag. Native defeat or genuine achieved surrender awards the exact Matron’s Anchor Sigil through the existing typed grant, once. Preserve death or nonlethal state; no finishing-blow loop, substitute loot or trophy seizure. The apparatus can then be studied for the received court report. Do not invent another boss, reset cleared rooms or close the return route.

Kharvess and Orrhask are the queen’s two unique finite retainers, placed by the encounter trigger. The queen’s explicit level 45 overrides the ordinary 27-32 local minion band. Preserve these established levels independently of player level. The open ascent, cover and signs of superior force encourage withdrawal or returning with companions.

Widow's Crucible - Outer Ring.description: Substantial pillars break the line of sight from the entry stair to the dais. Vhalessra intercepts intruders at their actual entry area with threats and preparations to bind or attack. There is room to take cover, defend, withdraw or attempt credible parley; no opening hit is automatic.

Widow's Crucible - Weaving Dais.description: Silver lines converge around a raised disk above slow ember vents. The matron works through a silver-edged spindle and the actual anchor apparatus. Low stone ribs can interrupt a direct rush or provide a flank; the pattern’s visible tension gives attentive opponents useful information.

Widow's Crucible - Anchor Recess.description: A counterweight cradle holds strain-fractured silver-black fittings. A silver-black fragment can break free when the matron’s hold on the web-anchor is overcome. Scoring, silk traces and a foreign transit fitting can support a specific report. Nothing here steals souls or erases the home passage.

Crescent Crown Fortress.name: Crescent Crown Fortress
Crescent Crown Fortress.basicInfo: The capital's upper stronghold occupies the higher northeastern shelf, reached by a rising, guarded approach. Thick pale-gray walls, square towers and practical slate roofs enclose courts, stores and offices. An enormous dragon skeleton curves around the stronghold's outer rock, making fortress and remains a single unmistakable landmark. The Jarl's Hall, Clans' Assembly House and Crescent Sanctuary occupy distinct precincts of this larger complex. Visitors come with petitions, official business or permission to see the public courts; the fortress is a working seat of government rather than an extravagant palace.
Crescent Crown Fortress.hiddenInfo: Outer courts can be busy without granting access to stores, command rooms or private apartments. Repair crews must respect both defensive masonry and the sacred remains beyond it. A difficult allocation of labor between a damaged wall and lower-city snow clearance offers a credible civic dispute, not automatic treason.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Ascending Appr.description: A zigzag stone approach climbs from the lower city to the upper shelf, its parapets broken by sheltered passing bays. Couriers, carts and visitors share the route. From below, the ancestral ribs appear beyond the walls like another range of pale cliffs.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Outer Arch.description: A deep archway narrows entry beneath heavy gates. Guards direct public visitors toward the court and examine freight destined for government stores. Their ordinary work is traffic, access and weather readiness; a portal credential is not a fortress appointment.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Public Court.description: Packed snow surrounds a cleared square between administrative buildings. Petitioners wait near a roofed notice wall, while laborers cross with timber and coal. Signs and attendants distinguish the routes toward the Jarl's Hall, assembly precinct and sanctuary.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Stores Passage.description: A vaulted corridor connects locked grain, fuel and equipment stores. Ventilation grilles breathe cold air across numbered doors. Deliveries are weighed here, and access depends on the actual job; scarcity cannot be solved merely by declaring the shelves full.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Inner Ward.description: A smaller guarded court separates offices from private residential rooms. Plain windows and covered walks speak of warmth and security rather than ceremonial grandeur. Authorized messengers wait under the eaves instead of wandering into the Jarl's household.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Rampart Walk.description: An inspected stretch of wall overlooks the lower roofs and neighboring peaks. Public access depends on weather and duty. The sacred skeleton lies outside the masonry; nobody uses its bones as a railing or convenient source of building material.

The Ancestor's Crescent.name: The Ancestor's Crescent
The Ancestor's Crescent.basicInfo:
The remains of the ancient protector lie in a vast crescent around the northeastern fortress shelf. Weathered ribs rise above stone walkways, the spine follows the mountain's curve, and the skull rests on a broad natural ledge. The founders sheltered under this dragon's protection when they were close to dying on the mountain; their descendants regard the remains as sacred history. The bones define the city's silhouette but do not generate its heat or mana. Keepers maintain respectful viewing paths and support fragile sections without turning the skeleton into a public climbing frame.

People associated with this place include: Keishin Tōdō — Crescent archivist and conservator; Miharu Sakuraba — Sacred-bone conservation craftswoman.
The Ancestor's Crescent.hiddenInfo: This is a protected resting place, not a relic quarry. Wind and frost can loosen scree around a support pier, giving conservators practical work without implying the ancestor is awakening. Offerings belong to the sanctuary's custody until properly placed or removed. The dragon's actual personal name has not been established.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Pilgrims' Appr.description: A broad stair ends at a low stone boundary where visitors brush snow from their boots. The first ribs loom beyond a turn in the path, larger than the buildings below. Keepers explain which sections can be approached safely.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Rib Walk.description: A paved route follows the outside of the rib cage behind a modest rail. Prayer ribbons hang from separate wooden frames, never nailed into the bones. Quiet conversation mixes with wind passing through the enormous spaces between the ribs. Miharu Sakuraba is usually based here, working as sacred-bone conservation craftswoman.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Skull Overlook.description: The skull lies beyond a respectful viewing distance on its rock shelf. Visitors leave lamps at a stone stand, with the fortress rising behind the curve of bone. The overlook offers no ordinary passage into the skull or beneath its unstable edges.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Spine Terrace.description: A sheltered terrace follows a section of vertebrae half-buried in old snow. Carved plaques recount the founders' refuge and later settlement. The path is useful for slow historical walks, remembrance and observation of the surrounding masonry.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Conservators'.description: Brushes, survey notes and temporary braces fill a low maintenance shelter. Keepers and stoneworkers compare cracks and snow loads before work begins. A visiting researcher can ask to examine the records; study of the remains requires actual permission. Keishin Tōdō is usually based here, working as crescent archivist and conservator.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Windward Bound.description: A final low wall closes the public route before exposed scree and cliff. Warning markers are practical, not a challenge to prove devotion. Beyond it, the bones continue around the rock where only trained maintenance parties venture.

The Jarl's Hall.name: The Jarl's Hall
The Jarl's Hall.basicInfo:
A long, sturdy hall within Crescent Crown Fortress houses the Jarl's public business. Dark beams, clan banners and a broad central hearth provide ceremony without lavish palace ornament. The Jarl is elected through the clan chiefs rather than inheriting an unquestionable throne, and governs a country whose clans retain substantial local influence. Petitioners seek decisions on roads, trade, defense and disputes beyond a single household. Access to a hearing depends on business and availability; being an impressive visitor does not automatically secure an audience.

People associated with this place include: Daizen Iwatsugu — Jarl of Drakenspire and chief of Clan Iwatsugu.
The Jarl's Hall.hiddenInfo: The office must negotiate support from chiefs, merchants and military leaders. A petition can be legitimate while competing with equally real needs elsewhere. Do not create an incumbent's name, family or secret allegiance merely to fill the room; establish a recurring person only when the story actually requires one.

The Jarl's Hall - Petition Porch.description: A sheltered porch holds benches, a public notice board and a table for sorting requests. A clerk distinguishes urgent harm from ordinary appointments. Visitors can learn the procedure without surrendering every detail of a private dispute to the waiting crowd.

The Jarl's Hall - Hearth Hall.description: The audience hall centers on an open hearth and raised working seat, with clan banners overhead. Hearings have witnesses, interruptions and practical limits. The room may be between sessions; an empty seat is not proof of a missing ruler. Daizen Iwatsugu is usually based here, working as jarl of drakenspire and chief of clan iwatsugu.

The Jarl's Hall - Council Chamber.description: A smaller chamber accommodates negotiations that need maps, accounts or difficult compromise. Thick shutters soften the wind against the fortress. Invitations matter here, and a public petition does not confer attendance at every closed discussion.

The Jarl's Hall - Records Room.description: Shelved copies of judgments, commitments and correspondence preserve the government's memory. Clerks retrieve relevant records according to access and condition. A public ruling can be consulted without exposing private testimony or giving visitors ownership of the documents.

Clans' Assembly House.name: Clans' Assembly House
Clans' Assembly House.basicInfo:
A broad stone chamber beside the fortress court provides neutral ground for the chiefs' deliberations and the election of the Jarl. Carved seats face an open speaking floor; the room is practical enough for ordinary budgeting as well as solemn decisions. Clan autonomy makes agreement necessary, while merchants and military leaders exert influence through testimony, resources and reputation. The assembly is not always in session. Residents come to hear public business, submit a grievance or learn which authority can actually resolve it.

People associated with this place include: Shūhei Iwatsugu — Clan Iwatsugu works surveyor and aspiring expedition leader; Noboru Ōhira — Clan Assembly recorder.
Clans' Assembly House.hiddenInfo: The country has more clans than the three prominent houses mapped in the capital. Do not invent a fixed electoral timetable, a universal vote for every merchant or an automatic hereditary successor. A chief's public position may reflect genuine duties to dependents rather than a single private grudge.

Clans' Assembly House - Delegates' Court.description: Clan messengers and witnesses wait beside stone benches and a covered water stand. Public notices identify the day's business. The court is a place for conversation and preparation, not an automatic invitation to overhear confidential bargaining. Shūhei Iwatsugu is usually based here, working as clan iwatsugu works surveyor and aspiring expedition leader.

Clans' Assembly House - Speaking Floor.description: A clear central floor faces the chiefs' benches. Speakers present claims, answer objections and refer to actual evidence. Disagreement can end in adjournment or compromise; every debate need not become a duel, election or national crisis.

Clans' Assembly House - Witness Gallery.description: An upper gallery accommodates permitted observers and people awaiting a call to testify. The low ceiling traps the warmth of the chamber below. Whispered commentary travels easily, and a visitor's interpretation is not the same as the assembly's decision.

Clans' Assembly House - Charter Room.description: Bound agreements, route obligations and old settlements are kept in plain cupboards. Custodians help locate a relevant clause while protecting fragile originals. Learning the law is possible here; changing a document does not change every copy or everyone's recollection. Noboru Ōhira is usually based here, working as clan assembly recorder.

Crescent Sanctuary.name: Crescent Sanctuary
Crescent Sanctuary.basicInfo:
This restrained sanctuary faces the ancestral bones from the fortress precinct. Its faith honors dragons as sacred beings and ancestors as people whose shelter, labor and choices made the present possible. Lamps, stone reliefs and woven memorial cloths fill a low, warm interior. Keepers conduct remembrance, receive offerings and teach the founding account. Outsiders may ask questions or sit respectfully without pretending belief. Religious observance shapes public life, but individual residents differ in devotion, interpretation and patience with ceremony.

People associated with this place include: Seika Amatsune — First Keeper of the Crescent.
Crescent Sanctuary.hiddenInfo:
Keepers preserve traditions rather than provide guaranteed dragon audiences or miraculous answers. An offering can express gratitude without purchasing protection. Disagreement over a festival expenditure or the conservation of a fragile object can be sincere on both sides; the institution is not secretly corrupt by default.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: First Ascent: A Light for the Cairns. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Crescent Sanctuary - Lamp Porch.description: Sheltered stone niches hold lamps protected from the wind. Visitors pause here to warm their hands and ask about the day's observances. Public notices distinguish memorial gatherings from ordinary visiting hours without treating every outsider as a suspect.

Crescent Sanctuary - Hall of Refuge.description: Reliefs show exhausted founders beneath a protecting dragon, followed by the first shelters and workings. A central aisle leaves space for quiet gatherings. The story is told as the community's foundation, not a prophecy identifying the newest traveler. Seika Amatsune is usually based here, working as first keeper of the crescent.

Crescent Sanctuary - Offering Chamber.description: Covered tables receive food, cloth and other accepted gifts before their proper disposition. Keepers record significant offerings and prevent spoiled provisions from accumulating. Gifts intended for a living dragon do not guarantee that one will arrive to take them.

Crescent Sanctuary - Memorial Alcove.description: Small family tokens rest beside names and dates in a softly lit recess. People speak to their dead, sit silently or share a remembered meal nearby. These objects are personal memorials, not random magical treasure.

Crescent Sanctuary - Keepers' Workroom.description: Repair thread, festival schedules and conservation notes crowd a practical workroom. Volunteers can ask about specific tasks. The sanctuary's care includes sweeping, recordkeeping and coordination with stoneworkers as much as public ritual.

Ancestor Cairn Terrace.name: Ancestor Cairn Terrace
Ancestor Cairn Terrace.basicInfo: Low cairns and family memorial stones occupy a sheltered terrace below the sacred crescent. Paths remain broad enough for winter funeral processions, with places to rest out of the wind. This is a living place of remembrance, used by clan households and residents without grand lineage alike. Visitors may trace local history through inscriptions or accompany someone paying respects. The terrace is peaceful more often than eventful; grief and ordinary care need no supernatural revelation to matter.
