Ancestor Cairn Terrace.hiddenInfo: Family accounts can disagree with formal clan histories. Access to a memorial does not make private letters or offerings available for looting. A damaged inscription can lead to restoration work with the family's permission, not the automatic discovery of a hidden royal bloodline.

Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Procession Gate.description: A broad stone gate opens onto paths swept after snowfall. Covered benches allow mourners to gather before continuing. Flowers, evergreen sprigs and wool wraps appear according to the season and household, rather than one universal ritual.

Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Family Cairns.description: Low mounds and engraved stones mark generations of residents. Some names are freshly cut; others have almost weathered away. Visitors can read public inscriptions, while private grief belongs to the people present rather than to a compulsory quest.
paths: Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Sheltered Remembrance Bench

Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Common Memorial.description: A plain wall remembers people whose families could not maintain a separate monument. Workmates and neighbors leave small lamps here. Its care reflects shared civic responsibility as well as religious custom.
paths: Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Sheltered Remembrance Bench

Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Sheltered Remem.description: A curved wall shields a line of benches overlooking the lower city. This is a quiet place to talk, eat a small packed meal or sit without speaking. The sound of festival drums can occasionally drift up from far below.

High Rampart Gate.name: High Rampart Gate
High Rampart Gate.basicInfo:
A fortified gatehouse controls the road from the inhabited lower shelf to the northeastern fortress precinct. It combines a switchback, inspection arch and sheltered waiting yard so winter traffic can be handled without blocking the entire ascent. Guards check appointments, dangerous loads and current restrictions. Ordinary people have business here—deliveries, petitions, repair work and religious visits—while access to military interiors remains separate. The gate's importance comes from its position, not from elaborate magical spectacle.

People associated with this place include: Reina Tachibana — Captain of the Upper Ward and fortress inspections; Hayate Mizusawa — Upper gate guard.
High Rampart Gate.hiddenInfo: A snow closure should have a visible reason and a practical review, not an arbitrary bribe demand. Guards enforce actual orders and distinguish a visitor's rank from local authority. A damaged cart or absent permit can create a solvable delay without making every officer hostile.

High Rampart Gate - Lower Switchback.description: A winding approach gives carts room to climb the grade without a straight charge at the gate. Snow poles mark the outside edge. People on foot use the inner steps and can see the lower city expanding beneath them.

High Rampart Gate - Inspection Arch.description: Under the heavy arch, guards compare visitors' stated business with the access being requested. There is room to stand aside while a delivery is checked. The inspection concerns the fortress; it does not revoke valid portal travel by implication. Hayate Mizusawa is usually based here, working as upper gate guard.

High Rampart Gate - Waiting Yard.description: A roofed edge of the yard shelters people delayed by weather or appointments. A brazier and posted notices keep waiting tolerable. Conversations here can reveal practical concerns, though nobody knows all government business merely from standing in line.

High Rampart Gate - Watchroom.description: The duty room holds route boards, spare cloaks and current orders. Entry requires a reason to speak privately with the watch. The staffing and readiness of a working gate persist after the player leaves. Reina Tachibana is usually based here, working as captain of the upper ward and fortress inspections.

Oathward Barracks.name: Oathward Barracks
Oathward Barracks.basicInfo:
Plain stone barracks house the hold's guard detachments and their equipment. A courtyard permits drill without turning the lower streets into a training ground. The force protects gates, patrols public roads and responds to violence; it is answerable to local government, not a branch of Glowhaven's strikeforce. Visitors can report danger, deliver supplies or inquire about lawful work at the duty entrance. Sleeping quarters, weapons stores and operational records remain restricted.

People associated with this place include: Gōki Shishido — Commander of the Drakenspire Hold Guard.
Oathward Barracks.hiddenInfo: The guard's competence varies by actual person, but the city is not defenseless because one patrol is busy. Resource tensions include winter equipment, road escorts and gate staffing. A credible report can change patrol priorities; an unsupported boast does not automatically mobilize the garrison.

Oathward Barracks - Duty Entrance.description: A small counter receives reports, deliveries and requests to speak with the watch. Wet cloaks steam on hooks behind it. Urgency is assessed from what happened and where, with witnesses and injuries treated as evidence rather than theatrical proof.

Oathward Barracks - Drill Court.description: Packed gravel and snow cleared from the center leave space for formation work and practical exercises. Racks hold training equipment during supervised use. The court is a workplace, not an open arena for challenging every guard. Gōki Shishido is usually based here, working as commander of the drakenspire hold guard.
paths: Oathward Barracks - Mess and Rest Wing

Oathward Barracks - Equipment Stores.description: Locked cupboards contain winter gear, maintained weapons and repair supplies. Issuing an item requires an actual assignment or authorized transaction. Issued equipment is logged, and shortages can delay an assignment.

Oathward Barracks - Mess and Rest Wing.description: Long tables and adjoining sleeping rooms accommodate off-duty personnel. The atmosphere is tired and ordinary between shifts. Access follows an invitation or official need; uniforms do not remove privacy or the need to rest.

Dragonwatch Balcony.name: Dragonwatch Balcony
Dragonwatch Balcony.basicInfo:
A broad sheltered lookout on the upper rock faces the high ranges. Residents watch changing clouds, distant wings and the paths by which trouble may approach. The gray guardian is occasionally seen far overhead, and such a sight draws serious attention, but the balcony is usually a quiet place for weather watching and conversation. It gives no view of a confirmed dragon lair. Visitors can compare sighting records, sketch the mountain skyline or simply appreciate the city below.

People associated with this place include: Kotoha Umezaki — Dragonwatch observer and weather diarist.
Dragonwatch Balcony.hiddenInfo:
A distant shape must not be identified with impossible certainty. The guardian's appearance can be a warning without specifying the threat, and absence promises no safety. Sighting records can support patterns, not an exact population count or a reliable schedule of dragon visits.

Rare authored contact: Rovakthuun begins off-stage. The actual rare-contact trigger controls a first physical appearance; looking for the being, purchasing a rumor or clicking this location is not proof of arrival. Do not generate a replacement, public lair or guaranteed meeting. Ordinary weather, tracks and fieldwork remain valid scenes.

Dragonwatch Balcony - Wind Screen.description: A thick wall breaks the prevailing wind before the open viewing edge. Hooks hold communal weather notices, and a narrow bench gives tired climbers a rest. Heavy snow can make the exposed part of the balcony unsuitable for lingering.

Dragonwatch Balcony - Sky Rail.description: A stone rail frames the jagged skyline above the city. On a clear day a watcher can follow distant movement for a long time. No observation here automatically reveals a creature's motives, identity or home.

Dragonwatch Balcony - Sighting Nook.description: A dry recess holds copied reports of unusual flights, weather and mountain disturbances. Dates and witness descriptions are kept distinct from interpretation. Comparing two accounts can be useful research without proving a new prophecy. Kotoha Umezaki is usually based here, working as dragonwatch observer and weather diarist.

Dragonwatch Balcony - City View.description: The lower roofs, procession streets and forge smoke spread below the balcony. It is an easy place to understand the city's two elevations. The immense bones remain close enough to anchor the view without becoming a bridge between districts.

Founders' Processional Way.name: Founders' Processional Way
Founders' Processional Way.basicInfo: A wide, gently stepped street cuts across the lower shelf, linking household districts with the central market and the ascent toward the sacred precinct. It is kept broad for dragon festivals, ancestor processions and ordinary freight. Wool banners and painted shutters provide color against snow and dark stone. Most days bring shoppers and deliveries; festival days bring food stalls, music and communal preparations. The street allows Drakenspire to be lively without turning every resident into a solemn warrior.
Founders' Processional Way.hiddenInfo: Festival arrangements are work: access, waste, carts, music and neighbors all need accommodation. A clash between a stallholder and a procession organizer can be resolved through space and timing. Decorations do not confirm that a festival is occurring today unless the scene establishes it.

Founders' Processional Way - Banner Step.description: Broad shallow steps descend between stone posts hung with seasonal cloth. Ramps along the edges carry handcarts and accommodate travelers who cannot use the steps comfortably. The posts mark a familiar meeting place rather than a formal checkpoint.

Founders' Processional Way - Procession.description: A widened section of street gives musicians and ceremonial groups room to form. Outside events, children, residents and delivery workers use the same open ground. Portable stands are stored away instead of occupying the square permanently.

Founders' Processional Way - Stall Reces.description: Recessed shopfronts can hold temporary festival counters without blocking the main route. Vendors negotiate space and cleanup with organizers. On an ordinary day the recesses shelter quiet businesses and people waiting out a flurry.

Founders' Processional Way - Carvers' Co.description: A sheltered corner displays repaired dragon masks, wooden ornaments and memorial boards. Artisans work on commissions in public view. Customers can discuss a design or watch careful handwork without every object being enchanted.

Hearthmarket Square.name: Hearthmarket Square
Hearthmarket Square.basicInfo:
The main lower-city market fills an irregular square with stone arcades and removable stalls. Butchers, wool sellers, household traders and carriers serve residents as well as visitors. Imported vegetables and grain arrive through trade alongside local meat, cheese and preserved food. The square provides shopping, small errands and news from the mountains, with public scales used to settle ordinary disputes. Its importance is daily exchange; a trip here can remain a pleasant errand.

People associated with this place include: Sachie Handa — Hearthmarket butcher; Eitarō Handa — Dairy seller and wool broker.
Hearthmarket Square.hiddenInfo: Weather can change availability and explain a quote, but not justify invented currency systems or arbitrary scarcity every visit. A short weight, damaged delivery or misplaced purchase creates specific stakes. Ownership, agreed prices and actual payment remain separate from browsing.

Hearthmarket Square - Covered Arcade.description: Stone arches shelter shops selling household goods and durable winter supplies. Meltwater runs in a channel outside the walking line. Customers compare quality and price while residents pause to exchange news with familiar traders.
paths: Hearthmarket Square - Wool and Dairy Stalls

Hearthmarket Square - Butchers' Row.description: Cold counters display prepared meat beside covered chopping blocks and hanging scales. Practical cleanliness matters as much as generous portions. Offcuts, orders and delivery times can support ordinary work without turning the stalls into a monster-part bazaar. Sachie Handa is usually based here, working as hearthmarket butcher.

Hearthmarket Square - Wool and Dairy Sta.description: Bundles of yarn, sheep cheese and wrapped provisions share a sheltered stretch. Local households sell alongside larger traders. The scent of wool and salt is interrupted by hot broth carried through the crowd. Eitarō Handa is usually based here, working as dairy seller and wool broker.

Hearthmarket Square - Public Scales.description: A roofed weighing table allows traders and customers to verify substantial loads. The attendant's task is measurement, not deciding every contractual dispute. An accurate weight can still leave a question about quality, damage or promised delivery.

Hearthmarket Square - Freight Lane.description: A narrow service lane lets loaded carts reach the rear of shops. Pedestrians yield when a team backs into a bay. Missing labels or an overloaded cart create practical problems with recognizable owners, rather than free crates to open.
paths: Hearthmarket Square - Wool and Dairy Stalls

Snowmelt Residential Steps.name: Snowmelt Residential Steps
Snowmelt Residential Steps.basicInfo:
Close-set stone homes climb the lower shelf in rows broken by shared stairs and drainage runs. Shutters, wool curtains and patched roofs show households living through long winters. This is a residential neighborhood rather than a public dungeon: visitors come to meet someone, rent a room or do an agreed repair. Neighbors share snow clearance and news, with friendliness varying by person. The upper fortress is visible between roofs, but ordinary life here revolves around meals, work, children and keeping the house warm.

People associated with this place include: Atsuko Ōhira — Neighborhood clothing mender.

Snowmelt Landing Flat is available by agreement: 1100 marks for the property purchase. Ask Atsuko Ōhira to inspect it and confirm the actual terms before paying.
Snowmelt Residential Steps.hiddenInfo:
House doors and personal rooms remain private. A blocked drain or roof repair can involve several neighbors with different means, without making the neighborhood destitute. Public gossip may be mistaken; knowing where someone lives is not knowing their private life.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: Room for One More Bench. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

PROPERTY TERMS: Snowmelt Landing Flat has a fixed opening quote of 1100 marks. Its native transaction supplies the key/deed and removes that price once when the owner agrees and the player explicitly commits. Do not also charge or grant it through item generation. A quote, viewing or gift of a key does not silently transfer ownership. Rentals cover the agreed stay, have no background rent drain and need a fresh agreement for an extension; purchases are permanent modest property with no automatic income or free specialist stock. Unavailable sold property is not offered to a second unrelated buyer. Ordinary room access stays local.

Snowmelt Residential Steps - Shared Stai.description: A broad stair passes doorways, stacked firewood and hooks for wet outerwear. Residents keep a narrow cleared line through fresh snow. Visitors can ask directions without treating each household as an open public interior.
paths: Snowmelt Residential Steps - Communal Wash Shelter

Snowmelt Residential Steps - Drain Court.description: Stone channels converge beside a covered drain that must be kept clear of ice and litter. Neighbors notice leaks quickly because water reaches their thresholds. A small maintenance problem can provide useful, ordinary paid work.

Snowmelt Residential Steps - Communal Wa.description: A roofed shelter offers basins and drying lines for local households. Water is supplied through managed distribution rather than by the sacred bones. Work and conversation overlap here, with privacy and access depending on actual custom. Atsuko Ōhira is usually based here, working as neighborhood clothing mender.

Snowmelt Residential Steps - Roofward La.description: A landing above the main stair overlooks a patchwork of chimneys and roofs. Repair ladders are secured when not in use. It is a good meeting place for a resident, not a public route into every upper window.
paths: Snowmelt Residential Steps - Snowmelt Landing Flat

Snowmelt Residential Steps - Snowmelt La.description: A compact landing flat with a sleeping alcove, tiny hearth kitchen, work table and sheltered gear cupboard.

Cinderstone Schoolhouse.name: Cinderstone Schoolhouse
Cinderstone Schoolhouse.basicInfo:
A medium-sized, plain stone schoolhouse provides Drakenspire's ordinary education: reading, arithmetic, local history and practical foundations for daily life. Its modest classrooms also accommodate some adult lessons and community instruction. It is not a fifth magical academy or a rival to Glowhaven's specialist institutions. Serious magic study often takes residents abroad to Glowhaven. Visitors may arrange an educational demonstration, deliver supplies or inquire about public classes through the office rather than interrupting lessons.

People associated with this place include: Aya Tsukino — Cinderstone schoolteacher.
Cinderstone Schoolhouse.hiddenInfo: The building's normal pupils may be children; the world's adult academy-student rule does not turn every local schoolchild into an eighteen-year-old. Adult public instruction and pupil lessons are separate. No named staff or pupil roster is established by this location.

Cinderstone Schoolhouse - School Entranc.description: Boot racks and damp wool line a modest entrance beside the office door. Notices list lessons and community uses of the building. Visitors announce their business rather than walking straight into a class.
paths: Cinderstone Schoolhouse - Reading and Records Room

Cinderstone Schoolhouse - Main Classroom.description: Plain desks face a chalkboard with sums, reading exercises and maps of familiar routes. Daylight enters through high windows. The room supports ordinary teaching, with the actual class and age group determined by the scheduled activity. Aya Tsukino is usually based here, working as cinderstone schoolteacher.

Cinderstone Schoolhouse - Practical Room.description: Measuring tools, simple models and sturdy worktables support hands-on lessons. Supplies are counted and stored after use. A guest can offer a supervised demonstration without transforming the room into an advanced spell laboratory.

Cinderstone Schoolhouse - Reading and Re.description: Shared books stand beside cupboards of attendance and lesson records. Adult learners may use the public reading materials at suitable times. Personal records remain with the school, while local histories can provide a starting point for research.

Lower Hold Gate.name: Lower Hold Gate
Lower Hold Gate.basicInfo:
The main overland gate stands where the lower shelf meets the descending mountain road. Snowbreak walls protect a broad cart entrance, a pedestrian passage and a sheltered inspection yard. Guards and road workers watch weather, loads and reports from the passes. Unlike the magical Portal Room, this gate opens onto the physical mountain routes. Visitors can arrange an escort, learn of a closure or wait for a caravan, while returning residents bring in livestock and supplies.

People associated with this place include: Kensaku Honjō — Lower gate duty officer.
Lower Hold Gate.hiddenInfo: Overland travel is possible but preparation matters. The gate should not become a new realm transition or secretly replace the authorized portal route. A closure follows actual conditions and can have alternatives; guards do not demand a Glowhaven portal key to walk a local road.

Lower Hold Gate - Cart Arch.description: A broad reinforced arch admits wagons and pack animals one group at a time when traffic is heavy. Guards keep the center clear while examining an unusual load. Snow chains and wheel damage are practical concerns here.

Lower Hold Gate - Pedestrian Passage.description: A smaller door opens into a sheltered footway with a view of the road. Travelers check straps and clothing before leaving. Posted warnings describe known conditions, with rumor and confirmed reports kept distinct.

Lower Hold Gate - Holding Yard.description: A walled yard accommodates waiting caravans, deliveries and animals. Water troughs and tie rails are maintained for actual users. A delay can create conversation or a small repair job without trapping the whole city.

Lower Hold Gate - Road Office.description: Route notes, patrol reports and supply schedules fill a cramped office near the gate. Staff can explain current advice and who maintains a road. They cannot promise that weather or territorial creatures will obey yesterday's report. Kensaku Honjō is usually based here, working as lower gate duty officer.

Iwatsugu Clanhold.name: Iwatsugu Clanhold
Iwatsugu Clanhold.basicInfo:
A substantial but practical clan house serves Iwatsugu households and dependents in the capital. The clan's long connections with stonework, quarrying and early settlement give it influence in repairs and public construction, though its members follow many trades. Petitioners discuss contracts, kinship obligations and support for local works in a public receiving wing. The clanhold is a household as well as a political address; visitors are welcomed according to their business, not granted free access to family rooms.

People associated with this place include: Tsubaki Iwatsugu — Acting household administrator of Clan Iwatsugu.
Iwatsugu Clanhold.hiddenInfo:
A chief can value both a sound wall and the workers paid to build it. Contract arguments need not conceal a coup. Membership is not established from a coincidentally shared surname, and a clan association does not prescribe every member's occupation or temperament.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: Three Banners: A Shared Road. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Iwatsugu Clanhold - Receiving Porch.description: Stone samples and old repair marks decorate a covered porch. Visitors wait near a bell and a table for delivery papers. Practical conversation often begins with which roof, road or wall needs attention.

Iwatsugu Clanhold - Common Hall.description: A broad hearth warms tables used for meals, negotiations and family gatherings. Work notices share wall space with memorial cloths. Business guests enter by invitation and may find an ordinary household meal rather than a political council.

Iwatsugu Clanhold - Works Office.description: Plans, measurements and agreed accounts occupy a small office. Clerks can locate the responsible contractor or explain a promised repair. A persuasive request still needs labor, materials and a decision before work is done. Tsubaki Iwatsugu is usually based here, working as acting household administrator of clan iwatsugu.

Iwatsugu Clanhold - Family Court.description: A quiet inner court separates the receiving wing from private rooms. Snow is swept into a corner beside stored gardening pots. Its domestic use should remain distinct from the clan's public offices.

Yukinose Clanhold.name: Yukinose Clanhold
Yukinose Clanhold.basicInfo:
Yukinose's capital house links rural households, provisioners and people who maintain routes through winter. Its influence rests partly on knowing how food, wool and freight actually reach the city. A busy receiving room handles letters, deliveries and requests from outlying settlements. The house is warm rather than lavish, with space set aside for visiting kin. Clan members are not all shepherds or carriers; shared obligations and history matter more than a single profession.

People associated with this place include: Masatsugu Yukinose — Chief of Clan Yukinose; Koharu Yukinose — Clan Yukinose route captain and provision escort.
Yukinose Clanhold.hiddenInfo: Helping one isolated settlement may mean delaying another load. Such choices can strain relationships without proving malice. The clan does not own every pasture or control all food, and outsiders can work in the same trades without joining it.

Yukinose Clanhold - Delivery Porch.description: Bundles, letters and travelers arriving from smaller settlements pass through a sheltered porch. A board lists expected loads rather than guaranteed stock. Visitors can leave a message or inquire where a delivery belongs. Koharu Yukinose is usually based here, working as clan yukinose route captain and provision escort.

Yukinose Clanhold - Hospitality Hall.description: A large table and dependable hearth welcome invited travelers and family business. Stew and wet-cloak steam mingle in the warm air. Hospitality is personal and finite, not an unlimited supply of free lodging for strangers. Masatsugu Yukinose is usually based here, working as chief of clan yukinose.

Yukinose Clanhold - Provision Office.description: Route accounts and household requests are sorted beside maps of the approaches. Staff compare need with what can actually move in the weather. A useful report from the road may matter more than an impressive title.

Yukinose Clanhold - Guest Landing.description: Simple guest rooms open from a quiet upper landing. Stays are arranged through the household. A traveler resting here remains a guest, not automatically a clan member or political representative.

Arashimine Clanhold.name: Arashimine Clanhold
Arashimine Clanhold.basicInfo:
Arashimine's clan house stands near the routes between the forge district and upper defenses. Its historic ties to arms-making and military service lend weight to discussions of contracts, training and readiness. The building is solid and restrained, with a receiving hall and an enclosed equipment court. Clan pride can coexist with ordinary domestic life, artistic interests and dissent. Visitors may bring a contract, a service petition or a personal invitation; the house is not a public challenge arena.

People associated with this place include: Tomoe Arashimine — Chief of Clan Arashimine; Akitsu Arashimine — Clan Arashimine weapons designer and contract negotiator.
Arashimine Clanhold.hiddenInfo:
A profitable commission may compete with repairs needed by local guards. Members can disagree over price and obligation without sharing one ruthless policy. The clan's martial associations do not confer command of the hold guard on every relative.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: The Blade That Passed: Under the Finish. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Arashimine Clanhold - Gate Court.description: A stout gate opens onto a cleared court with racks for deliveries. Visitors are directed to the receiving wing before unloading. Weapons stay sheathed during ordinary business unless there is a specific supervised reason to display them.

Arashimine Clanhold - Receiving Hall.description: Old campaign cloths and examples of careful metalwork line a warm hall. Conversations concern families and work as often as battles. Hospitality does not entitle a stranger to demand a duel or inspect private heirlooms.

Arashimine Clanhold - Contract Room.description: Tables hold specifications, delivery records and correspondence with workshops. Disagreement can turn on an exact requirement rather than someone's honor. Original papers remain with their custodians after consultation. Tomoe Arashimine is usually based here, working as chief of clan arashimine.

Arashimine Clanhold - Equipment Court.description: A sheltered rear court allows invited inspection and maintenance of equipment. It is used for practical checks, not public entertainment. Noise is kept within the working hours agreed with neighboring homes. Akitsu Arashimine is usually based here, working as clan arashimine weapons designer and contract negotiator.

The Hold's Judgment House.name: The Hold's Judgment House
The Hold's Judgment House.basicInfo:
A plain civic building handles complaints, evidence and hearings beneath the authority of Drakenspire's government. Residents bring damaged property claims, assault reports and contractual disputes here. Guards maintain a small secure holding space for immediate custody while matters are assessed; it is not Wraith Island Prison or a new realm. The public hall distinguishes testimony from rumor and permits ordinary disputes to be heard without turning every conflict into a clan feud.

People associated with this place include: Setsuna Takigawa — Judge of the Hold's Judgment House.
The Hold's Judgment House.hiddenInfo: Connections can influence who gets heard quickly, but do not erase evidence automatically. Street dueling and assault remain unlawful even when both participants boast of skill. Custody, confiscation and sentencing require actual events; location text alone does not transfer inventory or impose a sentence.

The Hold's Judgment House - Complaints D.description: A counter receives written and spoken reports, with benches for people waiting their turn. Clerks ask what happened, where and who can confirm it. They do not know a stranger's private history without being told.
paths: The Hold's Judgment House - Hearing Room

The Hold's Judgment House - Hearing Room.description: A modest chamber provides places for the presiding official, witnesses and parties to a dispute. Statements can be challenged and documents examined. The room is suitable for a small civil matter as well as a serious accusation. Setsuna Takigawa is usually based here, working as judge of the hold's judgment house.
paths: The Hold's Judgment House - Complaints Desk
The Hold's Judgment House - Evidence Office
The Hold's Judgment House - Holding Passage

The Hold's Judgment House - Evidence Off.description: Locked cupboards and labeled receipts track property submitted for a case. Access is supervised. An object being examined remains under documented custody; narration should not silently remove or return it outside an actual transfer.
paths: The Hold's Judgment House - Hearing Room

The Hold's Judgment House - Holding Pass.description: A guarded passage leads to a few temporary cells and a duty bench. It serves short-term local custody rather than an island prison sentence. A detainee's treatment and release depend on the actual case and authorities involved.
paths: The Hold's Judgment House - Hearing Room

The Tempered Fang.name: The Tempered Fang
The Tempered Fang.basicInfo:
This respected specialist workshop builds and maintains weapons intended to carry learned spellwork. Its smiths discuss balance, grip, channel behavior and the wielder's actual methods before recommending a design. Racks display varied practical forms rather than one compulsory Drakenspire fighting style. A spellblade can commission a blade, arrange a refit or investigate why a trusted weapon behaves poorly. Fine craftsmanship can support a user's abilities; buying an expensive weapon does not teach spells or guarantee victory.

People associated with this place include: Benjirō Kanemori — Master spellblade smith and owner of The Tempered Fang.
The Tempered Fang.hiddenInfo:
The workshop may decline an unsafe specification or recommend an ordinary repair instead of a costly replacement. Material provenance matters when rare scales, crystal or amber are proposed. Any numerical item effects must come from an actual supported item record, not a sales description alone.

CATALOGUE SUPPLY CONTEXT: Appropriate ordinary or specialist stock can include Whitepass Arming Sword; Snowchain Saber; Goatstep Boar Spear; Cairn-Splitter Axe; Hearthforged Greatsword; Ironbound Round Shield. These are exact itemTypes identities, not already granted items or guaranteed unlimited stock. Present a few relevant goods when browsing or a supply request actually happens, with real payment and ownership. Visiting does not buy anything. Rare teaching scrolls may enter a genuine specialist collection or discovery; do not place every scroll in every shop.

The Tempered Fang - Consultation Counter.description: Balanced samples and unfinished grips let customers describe how they fight. The discussion covers reach, handling and casting practice before ornament. A quote may change with the material chosen, but the reason should be explained.

The Tempered Fang - Fitting Floor.description: A clear floor and plain practice targets allow supervised handling checks. Customers test the feel of appropriate samples without striking other visitors. A good fit depends on the person, not simply their height or species. Benjirō Kanemori is usually based here, working as master spellblade smith and owner of the tempered fang.

The Tempered Fang - Channel Bench.description: Fine tools and magnifying lenses surround partly finished spell-channel work. Access is controlled because accidental casting can damage a commission. Inspection can distinguish a damaged conductor from a caster's unfamiliar technique.

The Tempered Fang - Proofing Booth.description: A stone-lined booth permits limited testing with agreed precautions. Marks on the backing record actual tests rather than promises of unlimited power. Completed work is released through the counter after its terms are settled.

Rivet & Rime Armory.name: Rivet & Rime Armory
Rivet & Rime Armory.basicInfo:
A practical armory supplies armor, shields and protective fittings suited to cold travel and hard use. Its stock includes shapes that accommodate horns, tails and different bodies without making every garment an exotic commission. Travelers seek strap replacement, sensible layers and equipment they can actually move in. The armory serves guards, hunters and ordinary workers; expensive decoration is available by commission but does not dominate the shop. A fitting can be a useful conversation about the difference between looking prepared and being prepared.

People associated with this place include: Hibiki Takanashi — Armorer at Rivet & Rime.
Rivet & Rime Armory.hiddenInfo:
The armorer can identify worn fastenings without diagnosing every magical curse. Borrowed or repaired equipment retains its ownership. A disputed fit may be genuine rather than a scam, and altering protective gear requires the customer's actual agreement.
