Rivet & Rime Armory - Display Room.description: Shields, protective coats and plate fittings hang beside clear examples of repairs. Customers can compare condition and intended use. The room smells of leather dressing and cold metal rather than constant furnace smoke.
paths: Rivet & Rime Armory - Strap and Rivet Bench

Rivet & Rime Armory - Fitting Alcove.description: Screens and a raised fitting platform provide privacy for measurements. Tail openings, joints and layered clothing are checked for movement. Staff treat bodies practically; a dragonkin customer is not a spectacle. Hibiki Takanashi is usually based here, working as armorer at rivet & rime.

Rivet & Rime Armory - Strap and Rivet Be.description: Small hammers and punches sit beside sorted buckles and leather. Minor repairs may be assessed here while the customer waits. Work still needs agreement, materials and completion before the item is restored.

Rivet & Rime Armory - Delivery Cupboard.description: Labeled completed orders are kept behind the counter, separate from general stock. Collection requires the correct customer or authorized messenger. A similar-looking shield on the shelf is not necessarily the one ordered.

The Woolen Wyvern.name: The Woolen Wyvern
The Woolen Wyvern.basicInfo:
A cheerful tailor and winter outfitter sells wool layers, lined coats, gloves and repairs. Its wooden wyvern sign is a shop joke, not evidence that the animal is sacred like a dragon. Customers range from local households replacing worn cuffs to visitors discovering how little their city clothes help in mountain wind. Practical cuts allow horns and tails room without sacrificing warmth. Bright cloth, careful stitching and candid fitting advice make the shop a comfortable stop between harder errands.

People associated with this place include: Shino Kazamaki — Clothier and owner of The Woolen Wyvern.
The Woolen Wyvern.hiddenInfo:
The tailor should recommend appropriate clothing rather than claim every item is enchanted. A rushed festival order or damaged travel coat can create work with modest stakes. A fitting or an admirer of an outfit does not imply romance or consent.

CATALOGUE SUPPLY CONTEXT: Appropriate ordinary or specialist stock can include Woolridge Winter Leggings; Whitepass Snow Boots; Snowchain Freight Cloak; Padded Traveling Cap. These are exact itemTypes identities, not already granted items or guaranteed unlimited stock. Present a few relevant goods when browsing or a supply request actually happens, with real payment and ownership. Visiting does not buy anything. Rare teaching scrolls may enter a genuine specialist collection or discovery; do not place every scroll in every shop.

The Woolen Wyvern - Front Shop.description: Bolts of wool and hanging coats fill a warm, colorful room. A small board lists ordinary repair services. Customers can browse without being pressured into a supposedly essential magical purchase. Shino Kazamaki is usually based here, working as clothier and owner of the woolen wyvern.

The Woolen Wyvern - Fitting Screens.description: Curtained spaces and mirrors allow private fittings. Hooks hold outer layers while sleeve and tail openings are checked. A comfortable garment should account for actual anatomy and movement rather than a generic human silhouette.

The Woolen Wyvern - Mending Table.description: Spools, patches and neatly sorted fasteners surround a broad table. Workers assess frayed seams and torn lining before promising a repair. An old coat may be worth keeping for fit or sentiment even when replacement is possible.

The Woolen Wyvern - Cloth Loft.description: A low loft stores seasonal fabric and unfinished orders away from wet boots. Access is by invitation. Delivery mistakes here involve actual labeled work, not a cache of free luxury outfits.

Coppercrest Exchange.name: Coppercrest Exchange
Coppercrest Exchange.basicInfo:
One of the lower city's conspicuously wealthy buildings, Coppercrest Exchange houses trading rooms, brokers' offices and a covered contract floor. Polished copper trim and tall glass windows contrast with the practical government buildings above. Merchants negotiate metal, magical raw materials and freight capacity here, often linking Drakenspire suppliers with Glowhaven workshops. Visitors can seek an appraisal referral, negotiate a consignment or find transport. The building is a commercial meeting place, not a bank that automatically grants accounts or credit.

People associated with this place include: Iori Yukinose — Clan Yukinose commercial envoy and junior festival patron; Saeha Kogetsu — Proprietor of Coppercrest Exchange.
Coppercrest Exchange.hiddenInfo: Reputation affects negotiations, but a fashionable office does not guarantee solvency. Competing deliveries, disputed samples and risk allocation provide ordinary commercial stakes. No new currency, tax schedule, financial mechanic or magical contract enforcement is created merely by this location.

Coppercrest Exchange - Trading Floor.description: Warm light catches polished rails around tables of samples and paperwork. Brokers introduce actual buyers and sellers rather than announce unlimited demand. A visitor can compare offers while remaining free to walk away. Saeha Kogetsu is usually based here, working as proprietor of coppercrest exchange.

Coppercrest Exchange - Sample Gallery.description: Sealed examples of metal, crystal and amber sit with declared provenance and specifications. Displaying a sample does not prove the entire consignment matches it. Buyers may arrange independent assessment before committing.

Coppercrest Exchange - Negotiation Rooms.description: Small private rooms allow parties to discuss price, delivery and liability. Walls reduce ordinary noise without promising perfect magical secrecy. Agreements remain the terms actually accepted, not whatever a bystander assumes was settled. Iori Yukinose is usually based here, working as clan yukinose commercial envoy and junior festival patron.

Coppercrest Exchange - Freight Ledger Of.description: Carriers and brokers compare available loads, routes and delivery windows. Weather and portal capacity can complicate a plan. A booking does not itself move cargo, issue a court key or grant access to restricted warehouses.

Coppercrest Exchange - Upper Reception.description: A tasteful sitting room offers a view across lower-city roofs toward the sacred crescent. Rich hosts sometimes use it to impress clients. The view and furnishings indicate wealth, not official authority over the Jarl.

Amberglass Assay House.name: Amberglass Assay House
Amberglass Assay House.basicInfo:
A professional assay house evaluates the composition, condition and declared origin of valuable raw materials. Mountain amber, mana crystals, unusual metal and legally obtained creature materials arrive in sealed trays. Its work supports trade and craft rather than serving as a grand magical research academy. Customers can request a defined examination and receive findings with appropriate limits. A certified sample can improve confidence in a deal, but it cannot guarantee every claim about a larger unseen shipment.

People associated with this place include: Takumi Hasebe — Assayer at Amberglass.
Amberglass Assay House.hiddenInfo:
Rare dragon gifts require credible provenance, not a convenient label. An unfertilized egg fragment or shed scale is neither a hatchling nor a guaranteed mana potion. Staff can refuse destructive testing of sacred or disputed property; results need actual work and do not reveal every hidden enchantment automatically.

CATALOGUE SUPPLY CONTEXT: Appropriate ordinary or specialist stock can include Mana Crystal Chips; Clean Amber Sliver; Coldglass Shard; Singing Basalt Core. These are exact itemTypes identities, not already granted items or guaranteed unlimited stock. Present a few relevant goods when browsing or a supply request actually happens, with real payment and ownership. Visiting does not buy anything. Rare teaching scrolls may enter a genuine specialist collection or discovery; do not place every scroll in every shop.

Amberglass Assay House - Intake Counter.description: Samples are received with their owner's account of origin and requested examination. Trays and receipts distinguish one customer's property from another's. The counter establishes custody before testing begins.

Amberglass Assay House - Examination Roo.description: Good light, lenses and calibrated tools support careful inspection of material structure. Appropriate magical methods complement ordinary observation. A test addresses a question; it is not universal identification of every secret an object carries. Takumi Hasebe is usually based here, working as assayer at amberglass.
paths: Amberglass Assay House - Sealed Sample Store

Amberglass Assay House - Sealed Sample S.description: Controlled cupboards separate samples awaiting work from retained reference material. Labels record handling needs and permission for destructive tests. Valuable fragments remain under custody until properly released.

Amberglass Assay House - Findings Desk.description: Completed reports explain what was observed, what remains uncertain and how the sample compares with its claims. Buyers and sellers may discuss a discrepancy here. A report is evidence, not a self-enforcing verdict.

Crystalcutters' Court.name: Crystalcutters' Court
Crystalcutters' Court.basicInfo:
A shared court of small workshops cuts, grades and prepares mana-bearing crystals for further craft. Covered benches face a cleared yard where workers can handle deliveries without crowding delicate work. The trade links mountain extraction with Glowhaven enchantment and local weapon making. Visitors can arrange a cut, seek advice on damaged material or watch permitted demonstrations. The court's expertise is specialized; a beautifully prepared crystal still needs an actual purpose, compatible construction and skilled use.

People associated with this place include: Hotaru Kise — Crystal cutter and bench artisan.
Crystalcutters' Court.hiddenInfo:
A flaw may come from the raw stone, storage or workmanship. Careful evidence can settle responsibility better than an accusation. Offcuts and discarded dust remain workshop material, and neither touching a crystal nor buying it automatically raises a character's Mana.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: A Stone for a Working Hand. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Crystalcutters' Court - Sorting Yard.description: Covered trays separate rough material by declared origin and visible condition. Workers keep heavy loads away from precision benches. A mislabeled parcel can delay several commissions without threatening the city's entire supply.

Crystalcutters' Court - Cutting Gallery.description: Protected windows allow visitors to observe cutting and polishing at safe distance. Fine grit and bright task lights mark patient work. Entering the working side requires a specific invitation and attention to hazards. Hotaru Kise is usually based here, working as crystal cutter and bench artisan.

Crystalcutters' Court - Design Bench.description: Templates and sample mounts help clients discuss a crystal's intended fit. Shape, flaws and available material constrain the result. A design consultation does not grant the enchantment that another specialist may later apply.

Crystalcutters' Court - Offcut Store.description: Small fragments are kept in labeled containers for reuse or sale. Staff can quote an appropriate batch for a real task. The store is not a limitless source of free magical ammunition.

Resin & Root Apothecary.name: Resin & Root Apothecary
Resin & Root Apothecary.basicInfo:
This compact apothecary sells prepared remedies and supplies practitioners with correctly handled ingredients. Dried mountain plants, resins and preserved creature materials occupy separate cupboards behind a plain counter. Customers come for ordinary care, preparation advice or a specific commission, not only rare magical cures. The proprietor's role is practical service; a reagent's unusual origin does not make it safe to swallow. The shop can connect field collection with responsible assessment and actual potion work.

People associated with this place include: Yoriko Tsumura — Apothecary and healer of Resin & Root.
Resin & Root Apothecary.hiddenInfo:
A useful ingredient still needs identification, preparation and a recipe. The shop's description does not invent new restoration values or guarantee stock of regulated mana medicine. A supplier's substitution can be investigated without making every remedy poisonous or every worker dishonest.

CATALOGUE SUPPLY CONTEXT: Appropriate ordinary or specialist stock can include Field Healing Tonic; Greater Healing Draught; Stable Mana Infusion; Bitter Stamina Tonic; Dried Mooncap Slices. These are exact itemTypes identities, not already granted items or guaranteed unlimited stock. Present a few relevant goods when browsing or a supply request actually happens, with real payment and ownership. Visiting does not buy anything. Rare teaching scrolls may enter a genuine specialist collection or discovery; do not place every scroll in every shop.

Resin & Root Apothecary - Remedy Counter.description: Wrapped preparations and labeled supplies sit behind a clean counter. Questions concern the actual complaint and intended use. A sale or treatment requires an agreed item or service, with effects limited to its real definition.

Resin & Root Apothecary - Ingredient Cab.description: Dry roots, resins and sealed specimens are separated by handling requirements. Visitors can discuss an ingredient without opening every jar. Origin and condition matter, especially when a mountain collector offers something unfamiliar.

Resin & Root Apothecary - Preparation Ro.description: A ventilated workroom contains scales, mortars and clean vessels. Staff prepare actual orders and reject contaminated material. Observation does not instantly teach a complex formula or provide the observer with its finished product.

Resin & Root Apothecary - Consultation N.description: A screened seat allows a quieter conversation about care or a difficult commission. Privacy is ordinary professional discretion, not an impenetrable magical barrier. Serious conditions may require an appropriate healer rather than a convenient bottle. Yoriko Tsumura is usually based here, working as apothecary and healer of resin & root.

Snowchain Freight Yard.name: Snowchain Freight Yard
Snowchain Freight Yard.basicInfo:
A walled freight yard gathers loads for the portalward quarter, local workshops and overland caravans. Roofed bays, chain hoists and broad lanes keep cargo moving without spilling into the market. Workers sort imports, raw materials and completed equipment while carriers plan around weather and access. Visitors can arrange a delivery, find legitimate day work or investigate a delayed consignment. Goods do not become unowned because they are outdoors, and a freight job grants only the tools and access actually agreed.

People associated with this place include: Tsugumi Arata — Snowchain freight dispatcher.
Snowchain Freight Yard.hiddenInfo: Mismatched manifests, damaged packaging and competing deadlines are credible problems. Portal authorization and freight handling remain separate: booking a load here does not issue a court key. Cargo cannot be copied into inventory merely because a worker describes its contents.

Snowchain Freight Yard - Dispatch Shelte.description: A roofed desk coordinates loads, carriers and collection times. Chalkboards show assignments rather than omniscient tracking. A missing delivery requires checking its last confirmed handoff, not guessing the responsible thief. Tsugumi Arata is usually based here, working as snowchain freight dispatcher.

Snowchain Freight Yard - Covered Bays.description: Numbered bays hold sealed freight above the snow. Workers compare labels before moving anything. Buyers, owners and carriers may have different rights to inspect or release the same load.

Snowchain Freight Yard - Hoist Lane.description: Heavy cranes and chain hoists move bulky loads along a clear lane. Bells and shouted warnings keep bystanders out from under suspended cargo. Helping requires suitable skill and supervision rather than a casual strength display.

Snowchain Freight Yard - Carriers' Room.description: A warm room offers benches, route notices and space to repair straps. Carriers exchange practical news while waiting for assignments. Some want conversation; others simply want their meal and a dry pair of gloves.

The Copper Ram.name: The Copper Ram
The Copper Ram.basicInfo:
A busy lower-city tavern serves substantial meals, drink and an easy place to spend an evening. A copper ram above the door is polished by weather and smoke. Workers, merchants and off-duty guards mix without becoming one friendly chorus. Storytelling, complaints and occasional music give the room life; the host expects weapons to stay out of arguments. Visitors can meet people or enjoy their food without being recruited into a quest just for entering.

People associated with this place include: Iroha Sagiri — Host and music arranger at The Copper Ram.
The Copper Ram.hiddenInfo: Alcohol, boasting and jealousy can produce friction, but public assault still has consequences. Tavern gossip is attributed and fallible. A regular's loud claim to have seen a dragon up close does not establish a known lair or rewrite the guardian's distant habits.

The Copper Ram - Taproom.description: Dark beams and warm lamps shelter close-set tables and a long serving counter. Conversation rises and falls with the crowd. A patron's free seat is an opportunity to ask, not automatic permission to join their company. Iroha Sagiri is usually based here, working as host and music arranger at the copper ram.

The Copper Ram - Hearth Tables.description: Larger tables near the fire suit meals and groups of friends. The smell of meat and onions clings to wool sleeves. People here may care more about a delayed wage or a bad joke than national politics.

The Copper Ram - Musicians' Corner.description: A small cleared corner accommodates a singer or a few musicians when someone is performing. At other times it holds ordinary tables. Music adds atmosphere without making every visit a festival.

The Copper Ram - Back Yard.description: A sheltered yard receives deliveries and gives patrons a place for cold air. Staff keep the service route clear. Arguments taken outside do not become lawful duels simply by leaving the taproom.

Hearthpot Stew House.name: Hearthpot Stew House
Hearthpot Stew House.basicInfo:
An inexpensive eating house near the market serves slow-cooked meat, broth, bread and seasonal additions. Its menu follows available supplies, with local cheese and imported ingredients appearing when trade permits. Workers value a warm bowl without ceremony; travelers appreciate being able to eat without bargaining over an adventure. The room is modest, crowded at mealtimes and quieter between them. Takeaway portions and agreed deliveries can connect it to ordinary local work.

People associated with this place include: Daisuke Toyama — Cook and proprietor of Hearthpot Stew House.
Hearthpot Stew House.hiddenInfo: Food nourishes and comforts without automatically applying a magical resource restoration. A short-handed shift or mistaken order can support a small scene. Do not turn the kitchen into an alchemy laboratory or make its regular meals secretly miraculous.

Hearthpot Stew House - Serving Counter.description: Steam clouds the glass near a row of covered pots. Customers choose from the day's actual offerings and settle the price. The counter moves quickly when people know their order and slowly when a large group arrives together. Daisuke Toyama is usually based here, working as cook and proprietor of hearthpot stew house.

Hearthpot Stew House - Shared Tables.description: Plain benches fit workers, families and lone diners into a warm room. Space for tails is negotiated with the same practical courtesy as space for bags. Conversation is possible, but a quiet customer can simply eat.

Hearthpot Stew House - Kitchen Door.description: The kitchen beyond a half-door contains busy cooks and hot equipment. Deliveries and work inquiries are handled without letting visitors crowd the preparation area. Smells and overheard orders convey activity without exposing private business.

Hearthpot Stew House - Pickup Window.description: A small window serves wrapped meals and agreed deliveries to people who cannot linger. Labels and collection times prevent confusion. Receiving someone else's order by mistake does not transfer its ownership.

Stonewake Onsen.name: Stonewake Onsen
Stonewake Onsen.basicInfo:
Drakenspire's one public onsen occupies a sheltered lower ledge where geothermal water is brought up and carefully managed. Stone pools, washing rooms and a warm rest hall provide relief from cold travel and physical work. Bathing arrangements respect privacy, hygiene and actual patron preferences; a shared bath is not an automatic romantic encounter. The springs owe their warmth to the mountain's geology, not the sacred skeleton. Fees, private bookings and treatments are ordinary services rather than universal healing magic.

People associated with this place include: Toki Toyama — Manager of Stonewake Onsen.
Stonewake Onsen.hiddenInfo:
Water temperature and maintenance matter. Staff may close a pool for a real safety issue while keeping other facilities usable. Do not establish extra hot-spring resorts elsewhere in this map or imply bathing cures every wound, curse or exhaustion mechanically.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: A Table After the Steam. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Stonewake Onsen - Reception and Shoe Rac.description: A modest reception handles fees, towels and current bathing arrangements. Shoes and travel gear remain outside wet areas. Staff explain available private or shared use without assuming every visitor wants the same experience. Toki Toyama is usually based here, working as manager of stonewake onsen.
paths: Stonewake Onsen - Changing and Washing Rooms

Stonewake Onsen - Changing and Washing R.description: Screened changing spaces lead to washing stations before the pools. Secure storage and clear etiquette protect privacy. Ordinary anatomy, including horns and tails, is accommodated without spectacle or compulsory nudity in narration.
paths: Stonewake Onsen - Reception and Shoe Racks

Stonewake Onsen - Sheltered Stone Pool.description: A broad pool sits beneath high eaves with an open view of snow beyond a privacy wall. Steam softens the cold air. Its warmth encourages unhurried conversation or silence, with personal boundaries still applying.
paths: Stonewake Onsen - Changing and Washing Rooms

Stonewake Onsen - Private Bath Rooms.description: Bookable small rooms provide separate bathing for those who prefer it. Availability and access follow actual arrangements. A reservation covers the agreed room and time, not unrestricted access to other guests.
paths: Stonewake Onsen - Changing and Washing Rooms

Stonewake Onsen - Rest Hall.description: Dry seating, drinking water and simple refreshments let patrons cool down before dressing for the weather. Quiet conversations linger here. Staff keep the room comfortable without turning it into a second tavern or medical ward.

Snowbell Playhouse.name: Snowbell Playhouse
Snowbell Playhouse.basicInfo:
A modest timber-and-stone playhouse hosts music, storytelling, comic performances and occasional community meetings. Its crowded cloak racks and practical benches matter more than grand ornament. Local stories may celebrate dragons or ancestors, but the repertoire also includes household farce, traveling acts and bad romances. Visitors can buy admission, ask about work or see a performance already scheduled. Artists and audiences can disagree about taste without threatening the national faith.

People associated with this place include: Suzune Hanekawa — Leading actress at Snowbell Playhouse.
Snowbell Playhouse.hiddenInfo:
A performance schedule is established by the actual scene, not generated as a festival every visit. Backstage accidents, an absent prop or a disputed booking can create modest opportunities. The playhouse has no automatically authored famous star or hidden cult.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: The Premiere Was Yesterday. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Snowbell Playhouse - Box Office.description: A small counter handles seats and posted performance times. Cloak racks fill quickly before a show. Questions about work or a booking can be directed here without interrupting a rehearsal.

Snowbell Playhouse - Audience Hall.description: Plain benches face a shallow stage beneath dark roof beams. Good acoustics make a quiet line carry. The room may hold an attentive crowd, a sparse matinee or no audience at all according to the actual event.

Snowbell Playhouse - Stage and Wings.description: Painted flats, ropes and stored props crowd the edges of a practical stage. Performers need room to work. Entry requires a reason and permission, and borrowed props remain the company's property.

Snowbell Playhouse - Rehearsal Loft.description: An upper room holds music stands, spare costumes and marked scripts. Rehearsal can be repetitive and unglamorous. A visitor may learn about local storytelling through conversation without instantly becoming part of the company. Suzune Hanekawa is usually based here, working as leading actress at snowbell playhouse.

The Cinder Pit.name: The Cinder Pit
The Cinder Pit.basicInfo:
A compact enclosed fighting venue gives Drakenspire a lawful place for public bouts. It is much smaller than Glowhaven's coliseum: a sunken fighting floor, close spectator tiers and practical rooms for competitors. Match officials establish the rules, permitted equipment and stopping conditions for the event. Spectators come for skill, rivalry and entertainment, while participants can test themselves through an actual booking. The existence of the pit does not make street challenges lawful or guarantee a safe mismatch.

People associated with this place include: Gentarō Bando — Match promoter and proprietor of The Cinder Pit; Tamaki Naruse — Cinder Pit wrestler and contracted duelist.
The Cinder Pit.hiddenInfo:
Fighters have actual experience and stakes; do not scale every opponent to the player's level merely to make a show. A disputed stoppage or damaged piece of equipment can be investigated. Betting or prize money exists only when actually arranged, not as an invented automatic system.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: The Cinder Pit Rematch. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

The Cinder Pit - Booking Desk.description: Officials register actual bouts, explain rules and assess whether proposed opponents belong in the same event. A boast is not a signed match. Equipment and medical concerns can delay a booking for practical reasons. Gentarō Bando is usually based here, working as match promoter and proprietor of the cinder pit.

The Cinder Pit - Spectator Tiers.description: Close stone tiers give the audience a clear view of the compact floor. Food sellers and ushers keep the aisles usable. The crowd can favor a fighter without becoming one unanimous voice.

The Cinder Pit - Fighting Floor.description: A sunken, maintained surface sits inside protective barriers appropriate to the agreed bout. Entry and commencement are explicit. A stopped match remains stopped; applause does not authorize continued violence.

The Cinder Pit - Competitors' Rooms.description: Simple rooms hold benches, water and space to check gear before and after a bout. Competitors retain privacy and ownership of equipment. A rivalry can become a conversation here rather than another compulsory fight. Tamaki Naruse is usually based here, working as cinder pit wrestler and contracted duelist.

The Cinder Pit - Treatment Alcove.description: A staffed alcove supports assessment and immediate care within available means. Officials can suspend a bout for injury. Healing is not an excuse to ignore damage or grant unlimited recovery beyond actual treatment.

Deepwell Waterworks.name: Deepwell Waterworks
Deepwell Waterworks.basicInfo:
A low utilitarian complex manages water drawn from deep mountain aquifers and distributed through protected channels and storage. Workers maintain pumps, settling chambers and freeze protection while monitoring the supply to households and public services. The city also uses geothermal sources where appropriate, including Stonewake Onsen, but drinking water and bathing water are managed according to their actual quality. Visitors may deliver parts, report a leak or undertake supervised repair work. The skeleton is not the source of the water system's power or heat.

People associated with this place include: Shigemori Abe — Deepwell senior maintenance engineer.
Deepwell Waterworks.hiddenInfo: Contamination, leakage and freeze damage require evidence and repair rather than a citywide curse by default. Restricted machinery is dangerous even without magic. Restoring a pipe is a concrete task; describing success does not automatically award an unrelated quest or repair the whole network.

Deepwell Waterworks - Maintenance Office.description: Route diagrams, fault reports and work orders fill a warm office. Residents can report a problem at a specific address. Staff distinguish the immediate complaint from the work needed deeper in the system.

Deepwell Waterworks - Pump Chamber.description: Heavy machinery and protected fittings draw and move water from the rock below. Noise and slippery surfaces limit casual access. Work requires appropriate preparation and permission, especially near moving parts. Shigemori Abe is usually based here, working as deepwell senior maintenance engineer.

Deepwell Waterworks - Settling Gallery.description: Covered channels and tanks permit inspection of sediment and flow. Workers take actual samples rather than judge safety from appearance alone. The gallery is a workplace, not a public bathing pool.

Deepwell Waterworks - Distribution Vault.description: Labeled controls and branch lines feed different parts of the lower city. An adjustment can affect several customers, so workers record changes. Closing a valve to solve one problem may require warning the people downstream.

Hoofstep Pens.name: Hoofstep Pens
Hoofstep Pens.basicInfo:
Sheltered livestock pens near the lower approach receive goats, sheep and working animals moving between pasture, market and households. Feed stores, inspection space and practical handling lanes keep the place busy. Herding is a major part of Drakenspire's food and wool economy without covering every mountain in farmland. Visitors can arrange transport, purchase through actual owners or help with a defined task. The animals are ordinary living stock, not automatic familiars or a combat encounter waiting to happen.

People associated with this place include: Uta Fumizawa — Livestock handler and seasonal wool grader.
Hoofstep Pens.hiddenInfo: A frightened animal, poor delivery timing or an uncertain health problem can disrupt work. Handling requires care rather than assuming a Nature affinity controls every creature. Ownership and agreed payment govern sales; a gate being open does not make an animal free.

Hoofstep Pens - Receiving Lane.description: Low rails guide arriving animals into the correct enclosure. Handlers check the owner's information and the animals' condition. Noise and unfamiliar people can complicate an otherwise ordinary delivery.

Hoofstep Pens - Sheltered Pens.description: Deep eaves and windbreak walls protect small groups from severe weather. Water, bedding and space need regular attention. Visitors remain outside the rails unless the responsible handler agrees to their help.

Hoofstep Pens - Feed Store.description: Dry storage keeps hay and supplementary feed away from damp and pests. Deliveries are counted before stacking. A shortage creates a practical supply problem with affected owners, not a reason to conjure limitless provisions.

Hoofstep Pens - Handling Yard.description: A small yard supports loading, basic inspection and careful movement of stock. People stand where handlers direct them. A successful task can be quiet and uneventful rather than a dramatic test of dominance. Uta Fumizawa is usually based here, working as livestock handler and seasonal wool grader.

Woolridge Pastures.name: Woolridge Pastures
Woolridge Pastures.basicInfo: Protected grazing folds and winter shelters occupy usable lower slopes beneath the capital. Goats and sheep move according to the season and conditions; deep snow makes stored feed essential. Stone walls and low buildings break the wind without erasing the mountain's difficulty. Visitors may help with an agreed delivery, inspect damage or learn about local husbandry. The pastures give the city's meat, dairy and wool a visible source, while imports still provide much of what the terrain cannot reliably grow.
Woolridge Pastures.hiddenInfo: The land has owners and working routines. A missing animal may be trapped, strayed or taken by a predator; tracks must establish which. Do not turn every pastoral visit into a monster hunt or claim that mountain herders have unlimited food in winter.

Woolridge Pastures - Lower Fold.description: Stone walls enclose a manageable patch of grazing and holding ground. Gates are kept latched for practical reasons. Visitors can speak with workers without scattering the stock across the slope.

Woolridge Pastures - Winter Shelter.description: Low roofed sheds protect animals during poor weather. Bedding and stored feed require regular work. Warmth here comes from shelter, labor and supplies rather than a permanent magical summer.

Woolridge Pastures - Shearing Shed.description: A clean practical shed stores shearing tools and sorted wool. Its busiest periods follow actual seasonal work. At other times it serves for maintenance and preparation, not a constant public demonstration.

Woolridge Pastures - Herders' Track.description: A narrow track links the folds and lower settlements, with sightlines across snow and rock. Fresh tracks can reveal ordinary movement or a problem worth reporting. The route is easier than the high ranges but still exposed to weather.

Winter Stores.name: Winter Stores
Winter Stores.basicInfo:
A practical depot holds public and contracted reserves of fuel, preserved food and winter equipment. Thick walls and carefully ventilated rooms protect supplies, while loading bays keep deliveries out of the residential stairs. The depot supports ordinary resilience rather than implying the city is permanently starving. Workers track what belongs to the hold, what belongs to merchants and what is already promised. Visitors may carry an authorized delivery, report damaged stock or seek the office responsible for an actual distribution.

People associated with this place include: Michiru Aonuma — Winter Stores distribution keeper.
Winter Stores.hiddenInfo: A reserve is not a free shop. Distribution follows real decisions and records, and the depot's contents should not replenish infinitely during a shortage. Spoilage or a bookkeeping error can be serious without being an enemy plot.

Winter Stores - Receiving Bay.description: Loads are inspected and counted under a wide roof before entering storage. Damp packaging and damaged seals are noted. A delivery is complete only after the responsible parties actually accept it.

Winter Stores - Food Vault.description: Cool dry chambers hold preserved provisions in labeled lots. Staff rotate supplies and check their condition. Visitors cannot infer the city's total reserves from one visible row of barrels.

Winter Stores - Fuel Shed.description: Covered stacks of fuel remain separate from food and open flames. Workers manage ventilation and safe handling. A small mistake here can be hazardous without requiring a magical saboteur.

Winter Stores - Distribution Office.description: Clerks compare requests, commitments and available stock. People can ask about a delayed allocation and present evidence. The office may explain a limit without being indifferent to the household affected. Michiru Aonuma is usually based here, working as winter stores distribution keeper.

Whitepass Watchpost.name: Whitepass Watchpost
Whitepass Watchpost.basicInfo:
A small fortified road post watches a vulnerable stretch of the lower mountain approach. Its garrison maintains warning signals, receives road reports and provides limited emergency shelter. It is neither a sprawling castle nor a second capital. Caravans stop to compare conditions and confirm whether a route is open. Work can include carrying a message, repairing a signal or checking an overdue traveler, with urgency determined by actual evidence rather than the assumption that every delay means an attack.

People associated with this place include: Yūsuke Ebina — Whitepass watch sergeant.
Whitepass Watchpost.hiddenInfo: The post cannot patrol every valley at once. A request should describe the last known route and reasonable risks, leaving the traveler free to decline. Emergency help does not confer permanent military rank or an unrestricted supply of equipment.

Whitepass Watchpost - Road Barrier.description: A movable barrier slows approaching traffic beside a sheltered guard position. It may be open during normal travel and closed for an actual hazard. Guards can explain the reason rather than demand a duel or arbitrary toll.

Whitepass Watchpost - Signal Platform.description: A raised platform holds maintained signal equipment with views toward the capital and nearby road. Weather limits visibility. A signal carries its established meaning; it does not transmit a complete conversation by default. Yūsuke Ebina is usually based here, working as whitepass watch sergeant.

Whitepass Watchpost - Shelter Room.description: A cramped warm room offers immediate refuge for stranded people. Space and supplies are finite. Sharing it can create ordinary cooperation between travelers without automatically forming a permanent party.

Whitepass Watchpost - Patrol Yard.description: Boot racks, spare poles and repair benches surround a small yard. Patrols prepare here and record what they actually observed. A missing patrol report remains uncertainty until someone checks the route.

Goatstep Hamlet.name: Goatstep Hamlet
Goatstep Hamlet.basicInfo:
A small inhabited hamlet occupies a sheltered fold below the city, with low stone houses, animal sheds and a shared meeting yard. Herding, wool work, repairs and trade keep it connected to Drakenspire without turning it into a miniature capital. The city can be seen from some paths, yet a bad storm can make a short delivery difficult. Visitors come for provisions, rural work or a quieter overnight arrangement. Residents have their own concerns and are not merely guides waiting for an adventurer.

People associated with this place include: Haruto Aonuma — Goatstep herder and hamlet representative.
Goatstep Hamlet.hiddenInfo:
Hospitality is offered by actual households and has limits. A family may want a fence repaired or a letter carried more than a monster killed. The hamlet remains inhabited through ordinary work; do not recast it as abandoned or secretly doomed for atmosphere.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: Tracks Beside the Fold. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Goatstep Hamlet - Meeting Yard.description: A sheltered open space joins the main houses and serves deliveries, conversation and small gatherings. A notice board carries practical requests. People recognize regular visitors, while newcomers can ask whose permission a job requires. Haruto Aonuma is usually based here, working as goatstep herder and hamlet representative.

Goatstep Hamlet - Wool Shed.description: Sorted fleeces and tools occupy a shared work shed. Workers discuss quality, orders and the weather while their hands stay busy. An interested visitor can learn something without receiving a full professional skill instantly.

Goatstep Hamlet - Guest Hearth.description: One household or host may offer a paid or invited place to sit, eat or sleep when available. The arrangement is made with the people present. A marked hearth is not an unlimited public lodging resource.

Goatstep Hamlet - Pasture Path.description: A stone-walled track leads toward grazing folds and the capital's supply routes. It carries animals, workers and small loads. Tracks and damaged fences can provide concrete clues to a local problem.

Pinefold Hollow.name: Pinefold Hollow
Pinefold Hollow.basicInfo: A limited belt of hardy pines gathers in a sheltered depression where the mountain permits soil and somewhat gentler conditions. Snow hangs on branches above narrow animal paths and occasional permitted gathering sites. The hollow offers botanical observation, tracking and small-scale resource work close enough to inhabited routes to suit prepared beginners. It is not a vast forest surrounding the whole city. Its quiet can be uneventful, with birds, creaking branches and distant wind providing interest without a compulsory encounter. The Animal Run passes feeding and resting cover used by mountain predators. The sheltered collection margin gives observers a way to study the signs before committing.
Pinefold Hollow.hiddenInfo:
Fallen branches, resin and plants differ in ownership and collection rules from cutting living trees. A territorial animal should leave credible signs before a confrontation. Sparse trees provide shelter but do not eliminate exposure or conceal every approaching creature.

LOCAL DANGER: The Animal Run passes feeding and resting cover used by mountain predators. The sheltered collection margin gives observers a way to study the signs before committing. Relevant creature types: Wild Predator; Great Bear. Establish actual present occupancy once the party investigates the relevant area; remember the encountered individuals, territory and outcome. A resolved defense, bypass or withdrawal changes the situation. Do not automatically refill the site or turn its safer approach into an ambush.

Pinefold Hollow - Tree Line.description: Scattered pines thicken where a rock fold blocks the worst wind. Snow changes texture beneath the first branches. Tracks entering the hollow can be followed with care, though overlapping prints may be difficult to interpret.

Pinefold Hollow - Resin Stand.description: Older trees show carefully tended collection points where gathering has been permitted. Fresh cuts and weather damage are distinguishable with examination. Taking material requires an actual right or agreement, not merely knowing it is useful.

Pinefold Hollow - Animal Run.description: A low path winds between trunks and rocks, marked by occasional fur or disturbed snow. Observation can reveal habits without forcing contact. A traveler who follows it is entering an animal's route rather than a maintained footpath. The Animal Run passes feeding and resting cover used by mountain predators. The sheltered collection margin gives observers a way to study the signs before committing.

Pinefold Hollow - Sheltered Clearing.description: A small clearing offers space for a rest or careful field notes. Broken branches and soot can reveal earlier use. It is suitable for a temporary halt with appropriate precautions, not a guaranteed safe campsite in all weather.

Glassmere Basin.name: Glassmere Basin
Glassmere Basin.basicInfo: A high basin holds a lake that freezes extensively in winter, with dark rock and snow framing its pale surface. The margins provide water observations, animal tracks and a striking place to understand local weather. Ice conditions vary; a smooth white surface is not proof that it will bear weight. Travelers may survey from firm shore, investigate a reported sound or watch wildlife at a distance. The basin is a natural landmark rather than an automatic entrance to an underwater temple. Thin ice at the margin and narrow inlet are the usual danger. Concentrated cold mana sometimes gathers into an Ice Elemental beneath a blue-lit fissure, where water trembles against the surrounding ice.
Glassmere Basin.hiddenInfo:
Deep cracks, thaw channels and wind-loaded snow can differ across the same lake. An apparent object under the ice needs examination before identification. Rescue or collection should account for rope, footing and the group's actual capabilities rather than assume every caster can freeze a safe bridge.

LOCAL DANGER: Thin ice at the margin and narrow inlet are the usual danger. Concentrated cold mana sometimes gathers into an Ice Elemental beneath a blue-lit fissure, where water trembles against the surrounding ice. Relevant creature types: Ice Elemental. Establish actual present occupancy once the party investigates the relevant area; remember the encountered individuals, territory and outcome. A resolved defense, bypass or withdrawal changes the situation. Do not automatically refill the site or turn its safer approach into an ambush.

Glassmere Basin - Shore Stones.description: Broad rocks offer a firm place to stop above the frozen margin. Wind has stripped some surfaces clear and buried others. From here a traveler can observe the lake without immediately stepping onto it.

Glassmere Basin - Ice Margin.description: Layers of frozen water and drifted snow meet the shore in an irregular band. Cracks and trapped bubbles reveal differing conditions. Testing a small patch does not establish the safety of the entire lake. Thin ice at the margin and narrow inlet are the usual danger. Concentrated cold mana sometimes gathers into an Ice Elemental beneath a blue-lit fissure, where water trembles against the surrounding ice.

Glassmere Basin - Inlet Gully.description: A narrow gully carries water into the basin beneath patches of ice. Exposed movement makes the footing unreliable. The place offers useful hydrological observations for a prepared visitor who respects the unstable edge.

Glassmere Basin - Lee Overlook.description: A low ridge shelters a viewpoint across the basin and surrounding peaks. Animal movement can sometimes be watched from here. The stillness is valuable in its own right, with no requirement for an apparition or attack.

Redvein Mine.name: Redvein Mine
Redvein Mine.basicInfo:
Redvein is a working mine supplying metal-bearing ore to the city. Reinforced entrances, haul lanes and a surface office distinguish it from abandoned workings nearby. Crews follow practical safety routines and restrict visitors around active extraction. A traveler may deliver equipment, undertake a supervised inspection or assist with a specific problem. The mine matters economically, but Drakenspire's entire life does not revolve around it; crafts, trade, husbandry and households remain equally real parts of the nation.

People associated with this place include: Isamu Murakoshi — Redvein Mine crew foreman.
Redvein Mine.hiddenInfo: A difficult seam, failing support or disputed sample can create work without a monster infestation. The active face is not an unrestricted dungeon. Extraction, transport and sale require actual labor and authorization; an ore description does not create inventory or instant wealth.

Redvein Mine - Surface Office.description: Shift records, delivery slips and safety notices occupy a stout building beside the entrance. Visitors state their business before entering the workings. Staff can identify the responsible crew without knowing every condition underground in real time. Isamu Murakoshi is usually based here, working as redvein mine crew foreman.

Redvein Mine - Haul Tunnel.description: Reinforced rails and haul lanes carry ore toward daylight. Passing places keep people clear of loaded movement. Noise and dust make communication harder, and a visitor must follow the crew's safety instructions.

Redvein Mine - Active Face.description: Workers extract a promising seam under maintained support. Access depends on current operations and conditions. Cracks, unusual water or a changed sound can require stopping work before the cause is known.

Redvein Mine - Ore Yard.description: Sorted loads wait under cover for weighing and shipment. Samples and entire consignments remain distinct. A buyer can arrange assessment without claiming everything visible in the yard.

Lanternamber Caverns.name: Lanternamber Caverns
Lanternamber Caverns.basicInfo:
Amber-bearing layers exposed in mountain caverns provide valuable raw material for careful extraction and study. Small lamps catch honey-colored seams in dark stone, while moisture and fractures complicate access. The entrance workings are managed; deeper routes are less reliable and require preparation. The amber's mana-bearing properties make it sought after, but its value depends on condition and usable material. Visitors can seek collection permission, survey a deposit or investigate a damaged shipment's source.

People associated with this place include: Madara Senzaki — Amber surveyor and contract field researcher.
Lanternamber Caverns.hiddenInfo:
The seams are not endlessly replenishing treasure. Removing material can undermine rock or destroy evidence useful to research. The cavern contains no guaranteed dragon egg or sacred bone; ordinary mountain resources should remain distinct from rare gifts left by living dragons.

Additional local creature possibility: Frostglass Leech. Use an actual appropriate individual only in a fitting occupied habitat or current problem. Safe services remain safe; this is not a mandatory spawn. Follow this location's level band and the least experienced human's ordinary-work risk, with warning before a deliberate harder undertaking.

Lanternamber Caverns - Keeper's Landing.description: A small sheltered station records entries, permitted tasks and returns. Lamps and route notes are checked before a party proceeds. Permission for one gallery does not automatically cover every deeper passage. Madara Senzaki is usually based here, working as amber surveyor and contract field researcher.

Lanternamber Caverns - Amber Seam.description: Warm-colored inclusions break the dark rock where a managed seam is exposed. Light makes them look more abundant than usable extraction may prove. Examination and proper tools are needed before a piece can be safely removed.

Lanternamber Caverns - Drip Gallery.description: Water falls through a narrow gallery onto slick stone. Mineral films and changing flow provide clues to conditions above. The passage is passable only with attention to footing and the actual weather's effects.

Lanternamber Caverns - Braced Work Niche.description: Timber and metal supports protect a small extraction niche. Tool marks and labeled sections show earlier work. A failing brace creates a repair problem before it becomes permission to blast the wall open.

The Abandoned Chainworks.name: The Abandoned Chainworks
The Abandoned Chainworks.basicInfo: An obsolete haul complex clings to a steep mountain face, its rusting chains and broken platforms once linking upper workings to the road. The system was abandoned when safer routes and changing yields made its upkeep impractical. Snow now hides gaps in decks and the mouths of old shafts. It offers industrial history, careful salvage assessment and difficult exploration. The ruins are dangerous through age and terrain even if no creature happens to occupy them. Lower machinery bays provide spider cover, while one surviving load-frame may react if its live operating marks are disturbed. Rusted platforms remain dangerous even when no creature is active.
The Abandoned Chainworks.hiddenInfo:
Old metalwork may belong to an existing claimant despite being unused. Weight-bearing structures must be assessed before use. A repair can open a limited route without restoring the entire lift system or creating a new region beyond the authored map.

LOCAL DANGER: Lower machinery bays provide spider cover, while one surviving load-frame may react if its live operating marks are disturbed. Rusted platforms remain dangerous even when no creature is active. Relevant creature types: Giant Spider; Clockwork Beast. Establish actual present occupancy once the party investigates the relevant area; remember the encountered individuals, territory and outcome. A resolved defense, bypass or withdrawal changes the situation. Do not automatically refill the site or turn its safer approach into an ambush.

The Abandoned Chainworks - Rust Gate.description: A sagging entrance fence and faded notices mark the edge of the old works. Fresh footprints are conspicuous when snow has recently fallen. The gate is a warning boundary, not evidence that everything beyond it is ownerless.

The Abandoned Chainworks - Lift Platform.description: A broad platform projects over a shaft beneath heavy, corroded chains. Missing boards and uneven loading make it unreliable. It should not move safely simply because a traveler finds an old control lever.
paths: The Abandoned Chainworks - Lower Shaft Mouth

The Abandoned Chainworks - Winch House.description: Frozen machinery fills a roof-damaged shelter. Manuals, wear and remaining parts can explain how the system worked. A competent examination may identify salvage or a limited repair without magically replacing missing components.

The Abandoned Chainworks - Lower Shaft M.description: An old tunnel opens beneath the lift structure, partly obscured by fallen debris. Air movement and water sound hint at depth. Entering requires a real assessment of support, light and a way back. Lower machinery bays provide spider cover, while one surviving load-frame may react if its live operating marks are disturbed. Rusted platforms remain dangerous even when no creature is active.

Old Hearthfall.name: Old Hearthfall
Old Hearthfall.basicInfo: An abandoned mining settlement occupies a fold beyond the maintained approaches. Roofless homes, a collapsed store and old drainage cuts show a community that dwindled as work moved elsewhere. Families left over time rather than vanishing in a single mysterious massacre. Descendants may still care about houses, records or memorials here. Visitors can examine the history of extraction, assess lawful salvage or trace how an ordinary settlement failed to remain viable in a difficult landscape. The empty house rows can shelter a predator or a small web pocket. Collapsed stores are unstable, with old beams resting unevenly beneath the remaining roof.
Old Hearthfall.hiddenInfo:
Abandonment does not erase ownership or turn every household object into treasure. Snow and decayed floors are immediate hazards. A family request to recover something should identify a real item and reason; the place need not conceal a supernatural explanation for economic decline.

LOCAL DANGER: The empty house rows can shelter a predator or a small web pocket. Collapsed stores are unstable, with old beams resting unevenly beneath the remaining roof. Relevant creature types: Wild Predator; Giant Spider. Establish actual present occupancy once the party investigates the relevant area; remember the encountered individuals, territory and outcome. A resolved defense, bypass or withdrawal changes the situation. Do not automatically refill the site or turn its safer approach into an ambush.

Old Hearthfall - Silent Street.description: Low walls and buried thresholds outline the former main street. Wind moves through missing roofs while surviving shutters knock against stone. Footprints can belong to occasional visitors or animals rather than a permanent hidden population.

Old Hearthfall - Collapsed Store.description: A broken roof covers the old supply shop. Shelving and labels hint at what residents once needed. Any surviving object must be assessed for condition and ownership before it becomes useful salvage.

Old Hearthfall - House Rows.description: Small homes stand in different stages of collapse. Domestic details make the settlement feel lived in and left behind. Entering one requires attention to structure, not an assumption that every floor is safe under the snow. The empty house rows can shelter a predator or a small web pocket. Collapsed stores are unstable, with old beams resting unevenly beneath the remaining roof.

Old Hearthfall - Drainage Cut.description: A stone channel once carried runoff away from the houses and workings. Ice now blocks sections of it. Following its condition can help explain damage without requiring an invented curse beneath the town.

Frostback Mountain.name: Frostback Mountain
Frostback Mountain.basicInfo: A neighboring mountain rises beyond the city's protective shelves, its broad snowfields broken by dark ridges and steep faces. Frostback provides serious climbing, high-altitude fieldwork and access to more remote terrain. It is visible from Drakenspire but not a casual extension of the market streets. Weather, fatigue and route choice can matter as much as any creature. Preparation and retreat are sensible parts of an expedition; reaching a viewpoint does not obligate the party to attempt the summit. The snow saddle and scree traverse are dangerous crossings in bad conditions. Beyond them, actual territorial mountain wildlife can obstruct a route; the marked base is a place to prepare rather than an automatic fight.
Frostback Mountain.hiddenInfo:
No dragon lair is confirmed here. A distant flight over the mountain is not evidence of one. Guides and maps can identify established routes while remaining uncertain about new snow, hidden fractures and territorial wildlife.

LOCAL DANGER: The snow saddle and scree traverse are dangerous crossings in bad conditions. Beyond them, actual territorial mountain wildlife can obstruct a route; the marked base is a place to prepare rather than an automatic fight. Relevant creature types: Wild Predator; Mana Beast. Establish actual present occupancy once the party investigates the relevant area; remember the encountered individuals, territory and outcome. A resolved defense, bypass or withdrawal changes the situation. Do not automatically refill the site or turn its safer approach into an ambush.

Frostback Mountain - Base Cairns.description: Old route cairns stand above the last relatively sheltered approach. Travelers check supplies and compare conditions before climbing. A cairn indicates a known route, not a promise that today's weather permits it.

Frostback Mountain - Scree Traverse.description: A narrow traverse crosses loose stone exposed between snowfields. Movement can dislodge debris onto people below. Careful spacing and actual climbing ability matter more than a dramatic declaration of confidence.

Frostback Mountain - Snow Saddle.description: A broad saddle offers a view between peaks but receives heavy wind. Drifts can conceal changes in the underlying surface. It is a natural place to reassess the journey before committing to a harder ascent. The snow saddle and scree traverse are dangerous crossings in bad conditions. Beyond them, actual territorial mountain wildlife can obstruct a route; the marked base is a place to prepare rather than an automatic fight.

Frostback Mountain - Upper Spur.description: A rocky spur rises above the saddle toward more exposed ground. The view is exceptional in clear weather. Reaching it is a substantial outing across exposed mountain ground.

The Buried Switchback.name: The Buried Switchback
The Buried Switchback.basicInfo: An old road climbs a slope where avalanches and drifting snow repeatedly obscure the bends. Some sections remain useful when conditions permit; others demand assessment or a different route. Broken markers and half-buried retaining walls show why local reports matter. Travelers might inspect damage, seek an overdue load or study snow conditions as part of a defined expedition. Terrain, accumulated snow and timing determine the avalanche risk. The buried bend crosses recent slide debris. Snow movement and unstable footing are the threat; the rock refuge is a genuine place to assess a safer method.
The Buried Switchback.hiddenInfo:
A slide should follow credible conditions or disturbance and leave consequences. Safe passage by an earlier traveler does not guarantee present safety. Rescue can involve locating, stabilizing and reaching people, rather than treating a powerful attack spell as the solution to every problem.

LOCAL DANGER: The buried bend crosses recent slide debris. Snow movement and unstable footing are the threat; the rock refuge is a genuine place to assess a safer method. No resident monster is required. Establish actual present occupancy once the party investigates the relevant area; remember the encountered individuals, territory and outcome. A resolved defense, bypass or withdrawal changes the situation. Do not automatically refill the site or turn its safer approach into an ambush.

The Buried Switchback - Warning Turn.description: A sheltered bend holds current warnings when road workers have reached it. Older notices may remain beneath fresh marks. Travelers should distinguish the latest report from a faded account of another season.

The Buried Switchback - Buried Bend.description: Only the tops of roadside markers emerge from a wide drift. The road's true edge is difficult to judge. Probing, route knowledge and cautious movement can matter more than simply walking toward the next visible pole. The buried bend crosses recent slide debris. Snow movement and unstable footing are the threat; the rock refuge is a genuine place to assess a safer method.

The Buried Switchback - Slide Fan.description: Broken branches, packed debris and disturbed snow spread below an avalanche chute. The surface can conceal cavities and unstable material. Tracks or cargo fragments provide evidence of an actual incident if one has occurred.

The Buried Switchback - Rock Refuge.description: A shallow recess behind a rock shoulder offers limited shelter away from the main slide path. It is a place to regroup or wait for better information. It cannot protect an unlimited group from every scale of collapse.

Skreek Crags.name: Skreek Crags
Skreek Crags.basicInfo: Steep crags beyond the safer routes provide perches and nesting sites for wyverns. These smaller, two-legged winged predators shriek over their territories and are regarded as troublesome pests rather than sacred dragons. Residents usually avoid their nesting ground instead of routinely organizing extermination. Observation, a necessary retrieval or a specific hunt can bring a prepared party here. Scored ledges, droppings and circling silhouettes warn of occupation well before close contact. Occupied nesting ledges are defended by their resident wyverns. Circling calls and scratched stone announce the boundary. The lookout permits observation and the scree route gives a real withdrawal option.
Skreek Crags.hiddenInfo:
Wyverns defend space and seek food; they are not convenient aerial mounts. The sacred dragons' contempt for them does not mean a guardian appears to clear every nest. A nest may be empty or active according to established evidence, and its contents are not automatically valuable loot.

LOCAL DANGER: Occupied nesting ledges are defended by their resident wyverns. Circling calls and scratched stone announce the boundary. The lookout permits observation and the scree route gives a real withdrawal option. Relevant creature types: Wyvern. Establish actual present occupancy once the party investigates the relevant area; remember the encountered individuals, territory and outcome. A resolved defense, bypass or withdrawal changes the situation. Do not automatically refill the site or turn its safer approach into an ambush.

Skreek Crags - Scored Approach.description: Claw marks and scattered remains appear along the rocky approach. The smell and overhead movement can reveal proximity to active perches. Turning away is a reasonable response when the route is unnecessary.

Skreek Crags - Lookout Crack.description: A narrow rock cleft offers partial concealment for observation. It gives a limited view rather than perfect safety. Noise, scent and changing wind can still draw attention from creatures above.

Skreek Crags - Nesting Ledges.description: Broad shelves hold tangled nesting material where the cliff catches sunlight. Reaching them requires an exposed approach. Disturbing an occupied nest has predictable territorial consequences without granting the animals new magical powers. Occupied nesting ledges are defended by their resident wyverns. Circling calls and scratched stone announce the boundary. The lookout permits observation and the scree route gives a real withdrawal option.

Skreek Crags - Scree Escape.description: A steep scree line leads away from the principal perches toward lower rock. Retreat requires care because loose stone moves underfoot. It offers another route, not a guaranteed escape from every pursuit.

Giant's Hollow.name: Giant's Hollow
Giant's Hollow.basicInfo: A remote hollow shows signs of use by mountain giants: enormous footprints, moved boulders and shelters sized for bodies far larger than local people. Its inhabitants and occupancy must be established through actual observation, not assumed from the name alone. The place is a serious expedition destination for tracking, study or a specific threat. Giants are not all mindless raiders, but entering an occupied camp without understanding its occupants is dangerous. The city remains distant enough that their presence does not imply a daily siege. Mountain giants use the moved-stone yard, carrying supplies beneath the overhang. Whether they warn, bargain or attack depends on the particular occupants. The high shelf affords a view of their camp without crossing the yard.
Giant's Hollow.hiddenInfo:
Speech, intelligence and motives belong to the particular giant encountered. Scale makes an ordinary movement dangerous to smaller people. Do not spawn a fixed boss or force a fight solely because the area name contains Giant; signs and choices should precede contact.

LOCAL DANGER: Mountain giants use the moved-stone yard, carrying supplies beneath the overhang. Whether they warn, bargain or attack depends on the particular occupants. The high shelf affords a view of their camp without crossing the yard. Relevant creature types: Giant. Establish actual present occupancy once the party investigates the relevant area; remember the encountered individuals, territory and outcome. A resolved defense, bypass or withdrawal changes the situation. Do not automatically refill the site or turn its safer approach into an ambush. Ordinary Giant types never replace Orrum; his existing rare-contact condition remains authoritative.

Giant's Hollow - Heavy Tracks.description: Deep impressions cross a sheltered approach where snow preserves their size. Their age and direction require interpretation. One set of prints does not establish the number, temper or present location of the inhabitants.

Giant's Hollow - Moved-Stone Yard.description: Large stones have been arranged in ways unlike natural scree. The space may serve work, shelter or storage depending on current use. A visitor can observe from its edge before deciding whether to approach farther. Mountain giants use the moved-stone yard, carrying supplies beneath the overhang. Whether they warn, bargain or attack depends on the particular occupants. The high shelf affords a view of their camp without crossing the yard.

Giant's Hollow - Overhang Shelter.description: A broad overhang shows wear and signs of occupation on a giant scale. Objects here belong to their actual users. An apparently empty shelter may still be someone's home rather than a treasure room.

Giant's Hollow - High Observation Shelf.description: A difficult side route reaches a shelf overlooking part of the hollow. It supports cautious study with a way to withdraw. Visibility remains partial, and a watcher should not gain omniscient knowledge of concealed occupants.

The White Silence.name: The White Silence
The White Silence.basicInfo: Far from routine routes, a secluded snow basin lies behind difficult ridges and long stretches of featureless white. Rare, uncertain reports describe enormous pale figures and tracks that disappear into storms. The basin is not a public attraction or a confirmed creature enclosure. Reaching it requires an actual discovery or reliable directions, followed by serious preparation. Its isolation supports quiet ecological observation and the possibility of an encounter with something most residents know only through disputed accounts.
The White Silence.hiddenInfo:
Yeti are real, rare and isolated giants in these mountains. Local people may only speculate about them; this narrator fact is not automatic character knowledge. The basin is possible habitat, not a guaranteed occupied lair or scheduled boss arena. Preserve the distinction between a track, a sighting and direct contact.

Rare authored contact: Orrum begins off-stage. The actual rare-contact trigger controls a first physical appearance; looking for the being, purchasing a rumor or clicking this location is not proof of arrival. Do not generate a replacement, public lair or guaranteed meeting. Ordinary weather, tracks and fieldwork remain valid scenes.

The White Silence - Unmarked Saddle.description: A difficult saddle opens into a basin without maintained markers. The route back can become hard to distinguish in poor light. Entering it should follow actual discovery and preparation, not an unsolicited shortcut from town.

The White Silence - Deep Basin.description: Snow and pale stone flatten distance across a broad quiet hollow. Wind can erase tracks rapidly. Large impressions may support cautious inference, but the observer must examine them before identifying their maker.

The White Silence - Wind-Carved Recess.description: A deep recess in the rock offers evidence of occasional shelter. Its current occupant, if any, is not visible from the approach. A traveler can withdraw rather than press a rare creature into confrontation.

The White Silence - Return Ridge.description: A narrow ridge provides a potential line back toward known terrain. Changing cloud makes navigation demanding. Leaving with notes or an uncertain sighting can be a complete expedition outcome without killing anything.

Stormscar Observatory.name: Stormscar Observatory
Stormscar Observatory.basicInfo: The ruins of an old weather and signal station stand on an exposed ridge. Its damaged roof, corroded instruments and shattered observation shutters record years of storms and deferred upkeep. It was a practical mountain station, not an advanced magical academy hidden outside the city. Researchers may examine old records, compare measurements or assess a limited restoration. Lightning scars give the place its name; they do not prove that the gray guardian deliberately destroyed it.
Stormscar Observatory.hiddenInfo: Surviving records can contain gaps and ordinary errors. Repairing one instrument does not restore the whole station or grant control of weather. The ridge is exposed during storms, and metal equipment requires sensible handling rather than dramatic disregard of danger.

Stormscar Observatory - Broken Signal Co.description: Stone mounts and damaged signal fittings occupy a wind-scoured court. The old road reaches this point before narrowing. Remaining hardware can be studied without assuming it is still operational.

Stormscar Observatory - Instrument Room.description: Bent frames and corroded measuring devices lie under a partly intact roof. Labels and wear reveal their original purposes. A usable component requires inspection and lawful recovery, not automatic restoration by touch.

Stormscar Observatory - Observation Shut.description: A high opening faces the ranges behind a damaged movable shutter. Wind and ice make the mechanism unreliable. Clear weather offers a useful survey view, while a storm makes lingering hazardous.

Stormscar Observatory - Records Niche.description: A protected stone cupboard contains whatever records have actually survived damp and neglect. Dates and missing pages matter. Findings should support specific conclusions rather than reveal a complete secret history of every dragon.

First Shelter Ruins.name: First Shelter Ruins
First Shelter Ruins.basicInfo: Old retaining walls and hearth traces survive in a sheltered fold associated with the city's earliest refugees. The precise approach is no longer part of the ordinary visitor route, though the founding tradition is widely known. Finding and assessing the site can illuminate how the first inhabitants survived before the mine settlement and fortress developed. Its importance is human history and dragon protection, not a hoard placed for adventurers. A credible identification may interest the sanctuary and local families.
First Shelter Ruins.hiddenInfo: The ancient protector's refuge is established history, but an individual ruin's interpretation still needs evidence. Preserve archaeological context rather than converting every object into a magical relic. Sacred remains, inscriptions and household material require appropriate care and permission for removal.

First Shelter Ruins - Hidden Approach.description: A narrow route between weathered rock and old snow leads toward low masonry. It is easy to miss without a lead or careful exploration. Discovering it reveals a site, not immediate certainty about every event that happened there.

First Shelter Ruins - Hearth Remains.description: Darkened stone and a shallow hearth survive beneath a protective overhang. Their placement suggests practical shelter from wind. Careful recording can preserve information that careless digging would destroy.

First Shelter Ruins - Retaining Wall.description: An early wall holds a small level space against the slope. Repairs from different periods complicate its dating. Its modest construction contrasts with the huge fortress built by later generations.

First Shelter Ruins - Weathered Memorial.description: A worn marker preserves fragments of a remembrance near the shelters. Reading it requires patience and comparison with other evidence. A partial inscription need not supply a new prophecy or the guardian's secret name.

The Old Offering Steps.name: The Old Offering Steps
The Old Offering Steps.basicInfo: A maintained but weather-sensitive stair climbs to a broad ledge used for offerings beyond the bustle of the city. Food is placed with care and removed when necessary; sacred practice does not excuse waste or dangerous accumulation. People come to give thanks, pray or look over the ranges. Living dragons occasionally accept offerings or leave gifts, but no one can summon a visit by following a shopping list. The steps are not a route to a known lair.
The Old Offering Steps.hiddenInfo: A shed scale or a deliberately left unfertilized egg would be a rare significant discovery, not recurring loot at each visit. Establish provenance, condition and local claims before collection. Bird or animal scavenging is an ordinary possibility and does not prove a dragon rejected a worshipper.

The Old Offering Steps - Lower Rest.description: A low wall and bench give visitors a place to check conditions before the climb. Keepers may post notices after heavy weather. Turning back does not signify impiety or failure of a quest.
